generic.Defined scope/population: Every peak peril and zone in the assumed plan book that the retrocession programme is meant to protect.
generic.In-scope period: The assumed plan year, matched to the retro programme period effective for that same year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attachment, limit, reinstatements, gross PML and net-PML tolerance present for each peak zone.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Zone count in the RMS PML output equals the zone count in the retro comparison workbook.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Alignment memo stored with RMS run reference, model version and retro schedule version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each zone left above net-PML tolerance logged as an appetite exception with the CUO decision.
generic.Test population: All peak perils and zones with plan gross PML at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where net-of-retro PML exceeds the appetite tolerance for any zone without an approved exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Head of Reinsurance routes residual net positions above tolerance to the CUO for a recorded decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed alignment memo plus net-PML-after-retro figures held for every peak peril and zone.
generic.Evidence location: Assumed strategy folder holding the signed memo with the RMS and Excel net-PML workings.

steps.title: Extract the retro programme structure into the Excel alignment workbook
sop: Open the in-force retrocession schedule and list each layer with attachment, limit and reinstatement terms.
Record the inuring order so occurrence and aggregate covers apply in the correct sequence.
Note the retro period so it can be matched to the assumed plan year being set.
Done when every retro layer is listed in the workbook with attachment, limit and reinstatements.
verify: Count the layers listed in the workbook against the retrocession schedule.
Pass when the workbook layer list matches the retro schedule with no layer missing.

steps.title: Run plan gross PML by peak zone in Moody's RMS
sop: Load the plan-year assumed exposure set and select the approved model version and peril region set.
Run occurrence PML at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods for each peak zone.
Export the gross PML table with the run reference and exposure as-at date on its face.
Done when gross plan PML at both return periods exists for every peak zone.
verify: Check the run reference, model version and as-at date are recorded on the exported table.
Pass when every peak zone carries a gross PML figure at both return periods.

steps.title: Apply the retro structure to gross PML in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Apply each retro layer to the gross PML by zone following the agreed inuring order.
Allow for reinstatement availability so exhausted cover is not counted twice.
Produce the net-of-retro PML figure for each peril and zone.
Done when a net-PML figure exists for every peak peril and zone.
verify: Recompute one zone by hand in Excel and compare with the platform output.
Pass when the manual recomputation agrees with the platform net-PML for the tested zone.

steps.title: Compare net-PML against appetite tolerance in the Excel alignment workbook
sop: Enter the net-PML tolerance per peril and zone from the current risk appetite statement.
Compare each net-of-retro figure with its tolerance and mark the zone pass or breach.
Show the headroom or excess in monetary terms for every zone.
Done when every zone carries a pass or breach marker against its tolerance.
verify: Check the tolerances used come from the current appetite statement version.
Pass when every peak zone is marked against the current tolerance version.

steps.title: List zones where gross plan PML exceeds retro capacity as gaps
sop: Identify each zone where plan gross PML sits above the retro capacity purchased.
Record the size of the shortfall and the peril driving it.
Name a mitigation for each gap such as extra retro, line reduction or a zone cap.
Done when every capacity gap carries a named mitigation and an owner.
verify: Check each listed gap has a mitigation entry rather than a blank.
Pass when no capacity gap is recorded without a named mitigation.

steps.title: Log residual positions above tolerance as appetite exceptions
sop: Log each zone still above tolerance after mitigation as an appetite exception.
State the residual net-PML, the tolerance and the excess for each exception.
Route the exception to the CUO so a documented decision can be taken.
Done when every residual breach is logged and routed for decision.
verify: Cross-check the exception log against the breach markers in the alignment workbook.
Pass when every breach marked in the workbook has a matching exception entry.

steps.title: Sign and file the retrocession and net-PML alignment memo
sop: Draft the memo stating net-PML by peril and zone, retro inputs used and gaps with mitigations.
Reference the RMS run and the retrocession schedule version relied on.
Sign the memo and state the plan year it covers.
Done when the signed memo is filed in the assumed strategy folder.
verify: Open the filed memo and confirm signature, date and plan year are present.
Pass when the signed memo is retrievable with net-PML figures and run references attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: All assumed classes of business written in the prior underwriting year across treaty and facultative.
generic.In-scope period: The prior underwriting year with two comparative prior years for movement analysis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written and earned premium plus paid, case and IBNR loss populated for every class.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extracted premium and loss totals tie to reinsurance administration system control totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loss-ratio pack stored with the as-at valuation date shown on every exhibit.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Classes more than 5 points above plan target logged with written driver commentary.
generic.Test population: Every assumed class of business with prior-year earned premium in the warehouse extract.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a class loss ratio cannot be reconciled to admin system premium and loss totals.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary refers unreconciled classes back to the Reinsurance Analyst before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Gross and net loss ratio by class with three-year movement and variance commentary.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI loss-ratio pack with the supporting warehouse extract and reconciliation workbook.

steps.title: Extract prior-year assumed premium and loss by class from the data warehouse
sop: Run the assumed portfolio extract for the prior underwriting year split by class of business.
Pull written premium, earned premium, paid loss, case reserve and IBNR for each class.
Record the extract run date and the valuation as-at date used.
Done when the class-level extract covers every assumed class with all premium and loss fields.
verify: Check no class row has a null premium or loss field.
Pass when every in-force class appears in the extract with populated premium and loss values.

steps.title: Reconcile the extract to reinsurance administration system control totals
sop: Pull total premium and incurred loss control figures for the same period from the admin system.
Compare extract totals with the control totals and quantify any difference.
Investigate and explain any difference before ratios are calculated.
Done when extract totals agree with admin system control totals or the difference is explained.
verify: Recheck the reconciliation at total and at class level for the three largest classes.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains between extract and control totals.

steps.title: Calculate gross and net loss ratios by class in Excel
sop: Calculate incurred loss as paid plus case plus IBNR for each class.
Divide by earned premium to give the gross loss ratio for each class.
Apply ceded retro recoveries to derive the net loss ratio for the same classes.
Done when gross and net loss ratios exist for every class in the extract.
verify: Recompute two classes independently and compare with the workbook output.
Pass when the independent recomputation matches the workbook loss ratios.

steps.title: Add the two-year movement comparison to the class loss-ratio workbook
sop: Pull the equivalent loss ratios for the two preceding underwriting years.
Show the point movement year on year for each class alongside the current figure.
Note any class where the movement is driven by a single large loss.
Done when every class shows its current ratio and two prior-year comparatives.
verify: Check the comparatives use the same class definitions as the current year.
Pass when class definitions are consistent across all three years shown.

steps.title: Flag classes exceeding plan target and write driver commentary
sop: Compare each class loss ratio with its plan target loss ratio for the year.
Flag every class more than 5 points above target.
Write the driver commentary for each flagged class covering rate, mix, large loss or reserve movement.
Done when every flagged class carries a written driver commentary.
verify: Check no flagged class is left without commentary.
Pass when each class over target by more than 5 points has a written driver explanation.

steps.title: Publish the class loss-ratio pack in Power BI
sop: Refresh the Power BI loss-ratio report from the reconciled extract.
State the as-at valuation date on every exhibit in the pack.
Attach the reconciliation workbook so the numbers can be traced.
Done when the pack is published with valuation date and reconciliation attached.
verify: Open the published pack and confirm the valuation date appears on each exhibit.
Pass when the published pack shows the valuation date and links to the reconciliation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assumed underwriting plan and every authority holder named in the underwriting authority matrix.
generic.In-scope period: The coming plan year, effective from the stated matrix effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per-underwriter line size, treaty premium income and any-one-risk limits populated for each holder.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Authority holder count in the matrix equals the count of in-role assumed underwriters.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed plan and matrix stored in the repository with version number and effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any holder without current competency sign-off logged and removed or approved by the CUO.
generic.Test population: All authority holders and all referral triggers listed in the proposed matrix.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any active matrix version is unsigned or lacks a plan-year effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Chief Underwriting Officer decides on holders or limits that fall outside the standard authority framework.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CUO-signed plan and authority matrix carrying the current plan-year effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository underwriting governance folder holding signed plan and matrix.

steps.title: Assemble the draft plan and authority matrix in the Excel governance workbook
sop: Bring the draft underwriting plan and draft authority matrix into a single governance workbook.
State per-underwriter line size, treaty premium income and maximum any-one-risk limits.
Show the changes against the expiring matrix so the CUO reviews deltas not the whole document.
Done when the draft plan and matrix are assembled with a change log against the expiring version.
verify: Check every limit column is populated for every named holder.
Pass when no authority holder row has a blank limit.

steps.title: Confirm competency sign-off and in-role status for each authority holder
sop: Check each named holder still occupies the role the authority is granted for.
Check each holder has a current competency sign-off that has not expired.
Remove leavers and movers from the matrix and record the removal reason.
Done when every remaining holder is in role with current competency sign-off.
verify: Compare the holder list with the current assumed underwriting team list.
Pass when no holder appears in the matrix who is out of role or out of competency date.

steps.title: Verify referral triggers are named explicitly in the matrix
sop: Check the matrix names new cedant, non-standard wording and peak-zone capacity as explicit triggers.
Check each trigger states the authority level it escalates to.
Add any trigger agreed during the plan review that is missing from the draft.
Done when every agreed referral trigger is named with its escalation level.
verify: Read the trigger list against the agreed appetite and plan document.
Pass when every referral trigger in the plan appears in the matrix with an escalation level.

steps.title: Review the plan and matrix with the Head of Reinsurance before signature
sop: Walk the plan targets and the matrix limits through with the Head of Reinsurance.
Challenge any limit that is materially above the expiring authority level.
Record the review date and any changes agreed in session.
Done when the review is complete and all agreed changes are made in the draft.
verify: Check the reviewed version incorporates every change agreed in session.
Pass when the version presented for signature carries all agreed review changes.

steps.title: Sign the underwriting plan and authority matrix with an effective date
sop: Sign both the underwriting plan and the authority matrix as approved.
State the effective date and the plan year each document covers.
Confirm no document is signed while any limit or holder remains in draft.
Done when both documents carry the CUO signature and an effective date.
verify: Open the signed documents and check for signature, name and effective date.
Pass when both documents show a CUO signature and a plan-year effective date.

steps.title: Publish the approved matrix and archive the superseded version in the repository
sop: Publish the signed matrix as the active version in the document management repository.
Mark the prior version superseded and record its retirement date.
Notify the assumed underwriting team of the new active version and its effective date.
Done when the approved version is live and the prior version is archived as superseded.
verify: Search the repository for active authority matrix versions.
Pass when exactly one signed matrix is marked active and all others are superseded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assumed underwriting team plus every active broker channel receiving the appetite briefing.
generic.In-scope period: The coming renewal season that the appetite briefing pack covers.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Target classes, territories, excluded perils and cedant tiering populated in the briefing pack.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Broker distribution list count matches the active broker channel list on file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Briefing pack and attendance and distribution lists filed with send dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Brokers not reached in the round logged with the follow-up date and outcome.
generic.Test population: Internal briefing attendees and all broker recipients of the appetite summary.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any internal pricing benchmark or net-PML tolerance appears in the broker version.
generic.Exception handling path: Head of Reinsurance approves any non-standard disclosure before it goes to a broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current-season appetite briefing with dated internal and broker distribution lists.
generic.Evidence location: Assumed strategy folder in the document management repository holding pack and distribution lists.

steps.title: Build the internal market briefing pack in the document management repository
sop: Set out target classes, territories, excluded perils and cedant tiering for the coming season.
State the changes from last season so underwriters see what has moved.
Reference the signed appetite document version the pack is drawn from.
Done when the internal pack covers classes, territories, exclusions and cedant tiering.
verify: Check the pack content against the signed appetite document.
Pass when every appetite element in the signed document appears in the pack.

steps.title: Produce the broker-facing appetite summary from the internal pack
sop: Cut the internal pack down to the classes, territories and exclusions brokers need.
Remove all internal pricing benchmarks, technical rates and net-PML tolerances.
Keep the cedant tier criteria at the level agreed for external release.
Done when a broker version exists that carries no internal pricing or PML figures.
verify: Search the broker version for pricing benchmark and net-PML terms.
Pass when no internal pricing benchmark or net-PML figure is found in the broker version.

steps.title: Deliver the briefing to the assumed underwriting team over Microsoft Teams
sop: Run the briefing session with the assumed underwriting team and walk the pack through.
Take questions on classes that have moved in or out of appetite.
Record the attendance list from the session.
Done when the session is delivered and the attendance list is captured.
verify: Compare the attendance list with the assumed underwriting team list.
Pass when every underwriter either attended or has a recorded catch-up date.

steps.title: Send the broker version to each active broker channel by email
sop: Send the broker appetite summary to the named contact at each active broker channel.
Record the send date and recipient against each broker channel.
Chase any channel where no contact of record exists and obtain one.
Done when every active broker channel has been sent the summary with the date logged.
verify: Compare the send log with the active broker channel list.
Pass when every active broker channel has a recorded send date.

steps.title: File the briefing pack and distribution lists in the assumed strategy folder
sop: File the internal pack, the broker version and both distribution lists together.
Tag the filing with the renewal season it covers.
Confirm the filed broker version is the one actually sent.
Done when pack, broker version and both dated lists are filed together.
verify: Open the filed set and check both distribution lists carry dates.
Pass when the filed pack includes dated internal and broker distribution lists.

steps.title: Confirm briefing coverage and log follow-ups with the underwriting team
sop: Review attendance and broker send logs for anyone not reached.
Arrange a catch-up briefing or resend for each gap and record the date.
Close the round once every gap has a recorded follow-up outcome.
Done when every unreached recipient has a logged follow-up outcome.
verify: Read the follow-up log against the gaps identified.
Pass when no identified gap is left without a follow-up outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Proportional treaty, non-proportional treaty and facultative business across all lines and territories.
generic.In-scope period: The plan year the appetite document is stated to be effective from.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line of business, territory scope, class exclusions and cedant tier criteria populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every line of business in the plan appears once in the appetite table with a territory scope.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed appetite document filed with version number and effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Classes proposed but not agreed logged with the decision and rationale.
generic.Test population: All accepted lines of business, all prohibited classes and all cedant tier definitions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any prohibited class or no-write cedant is referenced indirectly rather than named.
generic.Exception handling path: Head of Reinsurance escalates any proposed appetite widening to the CUO before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed appetite covering LOB, territory, class exclusions and cedant tier with named prohibitions.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository assumed appetite folder holding the signed effective version.

steps.title: Draft the appetite structure by business type in the Excel appetite workbook
sop: Create separate appetite sections for proportional treaty, non-proportional treaty and facultative.
Carry the plan targets into each section so appetite and plan are consistent.
Mark each section with the plan year it applies to.
Done when all three business types have their own appetite section in the workbook.
verify: Check each business type section exists and is populated.
Pass when proportional, non-proportional and facultative each carry a stated appetite.

steps.title: List accepted lines of business with territory scope and class exclusions
sop: List every accepted line of business with the territories it may be written in.
State the class exclusions such as cyber, mortgage and financial guarantee against each line.
Confirm territory scope wording is precise enough to be applied at submission.
Done when every accepted line carries a territory scope and exclusion list.
verify: Check no accepted line is left with a blank territory or exclusion column.
Pass when every accepted line has both territory scope and exclusions stated.

steps.title: Define cedant tier criteria with minimum financial-strength ratings
sop: Define tier 1, tier 2 and tier 3 cedant criteria in the appetite workbook.
State the minimum financial-strength rating required for each tier.
State what line size each tier supports so the tier drives a real decision.
Done when all three tiers have rating thresholds and supported line sizes.
verify: Check each tier definition names a minimum rating and a supported line size.
Pass when no tier definition is left without a rating threshold.

steps.title: Name prohibited classes and no-write cedants explicitly in the document
sop: List every prohibited class by name rather than by cross-reference to another document.
List every no-write cedant by legal entity name and group.
State the reason each entry is prohibited so it can be reviewed next year.
Done when the prohibited-class and no-write lists are named in full inside the document.
verify: Search the document for cross-references in place of named entries.
Pass when no prohibited class or no-write cedant is stated only by reference.

steps.title: Circulate the appetite document for CUO and Head of Reinsurance sign-off
sop: Circulate the completed appetite document for CUO and Head of Reinsurance approval.
Capture both signatures and the effective date on the document face.
Hold release until both signatures are present.
Done when the document carries both signatures and a stated effective date.
verify: Open the signed document and check both signatures and the effective date.
Pass when the appetite document is signed by both approvers with an effective date.

steps.title: Publish the signed appetite version to the document management repository
sop: Publish the signed version as the active appetite document with its version number.
Attach the prohibited-class and no-write list to the same repository entry.
Supersede the prior year version and record its retirement date.
Done when the signed version is active with the prohibition list attached.
verify: Search the repository for active appetite documents.
Pass when exactly one signed appetite version is active with its prohibition list attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every assumed class of business in the plan, split by layer band for non-proportional treaty.
generic.In-scope period: The plan year the benchmarks and target combined ratios are set for.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Target loss ratio, expense and brokerage load and target combined ratio present per class.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Class list in the benchmark set matches the class list in the signed appetite document.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark workbook stored with model version, data as-at date and peer review sign-off.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Classes where the benchmark cannot be supported logged with the actuarial rationale.
generic.Test population: All assumed classes and all non-proportional layer bands in the benchmark set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any class benchmark is released without actuarial peer review sign-off.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary refers unsupported benchmark bases to the Head of Reinsurance before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Target combined ratio and minimum rate-on-line held per class and layer band with peer review.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modeling platform benchmark run plus the Excel benchmark workbook for the plan year.

steps.title: Set target loss ratio and expense loads per class in the Excel benchmark workbook
sop: Set the target loss ratio for each assumed class from experience and plan assumptions.
Add the expense and brokerage load applicable to each class.
Derive the target combined ratio for the class from those components.
Done when every class carries a target loss ratio, load and combined ratio.
verify: Recompute the combined ratio for two classes from their components.
Pass when the recomputed combined ratios match the workbook values.

steps.title: Derive minimum rate-on-line by layer band in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Run the layer pricing basis for each non-proportional layer band in the plan.
Derive the minimum acceptable rate-on-line consistent with the target combined ratio.
Record the severity curve and parameter set used for each band.
Done when every layer band has a minimum rate-on-line with its curve reference.
verify: Check each layer band carries a curve reference and a minimum rate-on-line.
Pass when no layer band is left without a documented minimum rate-on-line.

steps.title: Set maximum ceding commission and sliding-scale ranges by class
sop: Set the maximum flat ceding commission acceptable on proportional treaties per class.
Set the sliding-scale minimum, provisional and maximum points where sliding scales are used.
Check the scale still delivers the target combined ratio at the plan loss ratio.
Done when every proportional class has a commission ceiling and scale range.
verify: Test the scale at plan loss ratio for one class and read the resulting combined ratio.
Pass when the tested scale delivers a combined ratio at or below the class target.

steps.title: Show the cost-of-capital loading bridging technical price to target combined ratio
sop: State the capital charge basis and the cost-of-capital rate applied.
Show the loading in the bridge from technical price to target combined ratio per class.
Flag any class where the loading makes the target unachievable at market rates.
Done when the cost-of-capital bridge is shown for every class.
verify: Check the bridge reconciles technical price to target combined ratio for each class.
Pass when the bridge reconciles without a residual unexplained gap.

steps.title: Obtain actuarial peer review sign-off on the benchmark basis
sop: Present the benchmark basis, curves and loadings for peer review.
Record the reviewer name, date and any changes required.
Hold release to underwriters until the review is signed off.
Done when peer review sign-off is recorded on the benchmark basis.
verify: Check the sign-off record shows reviewer name and date before the release date.
Pass when peer review sign-off predates distribution of the benchmarks.

steps.title: Release the benchmark set to underwriters with version and as-at date
sop: Publish the benchmark workbook with its version number and data as-at date.
Confirm the class list matches the signed appetite document class list.
Notify assumed underwriters that the new benchmark version is in force.
Done when the versioned benchmark set is released to the underwriting team.
verify: Compare the released class list with the signed appetite class list.
Pass when the released benchmark class list matches the appetite class list.

generic.Defined scope/population: The whole assumed portfolio by class, territory, cedant tier and broker channel for the quarter.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter just closed with year-to-date and plan comparatives.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written premium, signed lines, estimated ultimate loss ratio and plan figures populated per class.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Power BI premium totals reconcile to reinsurance administration system quarter-end totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Quarterly pack and minutes stored with the data refresh timestamp shown.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Classes more than 10% off plan premium logged with a written variance note and action.
generic.Test population: All classes, territories and cedant tiers with quarter written premium in the portfolio pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any class more than 10% off plan premium has no written variance note.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager escalates persistent off-plan classes to the Head of Reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Actual-versus-plan premium, mix and loss ratio by class with dated minutes and named action owners.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI quarterly portfolio report plus the filed review minutes for the quarter.

steps.title: Refresh the quarterly assumed portfolio pack in Power BI
sop: Refresh the portfolio dataset from the warehouse for the closed quarter.
Populate written premium, signed lines and estimated ultimate loss ratio versus plan by class.
Record the data refresh timestamp on the report face.
Done when the pack shows quarter actuals against plan for every class.
verify: Check the refresh timestamp is after quarter close.
Pass when the pack refresh timestamp falls after the quarter-end close date.

steps.title: Reconcile pack premium to the reinsurance administration system
sop: Pull quarter-end written premium control totals from the administration system.
Compare with the Power BI premium total and quantify any difference.
Investigate differences above the agreed tolerance before the pack is circulated.
Done when pack premium agrees with admin system totals or the difference is explained.
verify: Recheck the reconciliation for the two largest classes by premium.
Pass when no unexplained premium difference remains at total or class level.

steps.title: Report business mix against planned mix percentages
sop: Show the mix of written premium by class, territory and cedant tier.
Compare each mix percentage with the planned mix for the year.
Highlight the segments furthest from planned mix.
Done when actual and planned mix percentages are shown for all three dimensions.
verify: Check the mix percentages sum to 100 on each dimension.
Pass when each mix dimension totals 100 percent with no unallocated premium.

steps.title: Report hit ratio and average signed line by broker channel
sop: Calculate quote and bind counts per broker channel for the quarter.
Report the hit ratio and the average signed line for each channel.
Note any channel where the hit ratio has moved materially from the prior quarter.
Done when hit ratio and average signed line are reported per broker channel.
verify: Check the bind count per channel ties to bound treaty records for the quarter.
Pass when channel bind counts reconcile to bound records in the admin system.

steps.title: Write variance notes for classes more than 10% off plan premium
sop: Identify every class more than 10% above or below plan premium.
Write the variance note covering rate, volume, mix or timing drivers.
State whether the variance is expected to persist for the rest of the year.
Done when every class more than 10% off plan carries a written variance note.
verify: Check the variance note list against the off-plan class list.
Pass when no class more than 10% off plan lacks a variance note.

steps.title: Hold the quarterly review and record actions with named owners
sop: Hold the review with the pack, mix and variance notes as the agenda.
Agree actions for each material variance with a named owner and due date.
Record the review date, attendees and the agreed actions.
Done when dated minutes exist listing every action with an owner and due date.
verify: Read the minutes against the variance note list.
Pass when every variance requiring action has a named owner and due date in the minutes.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every appetite or accumulation limit breached during the quarter across the assumed book.
generic.In-scope period: The quarter in which the breaches occurred, with the remaining plan year for the effect.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Breach size, duration, proposed action and quantified premium and net-PML effect populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Breach count in the recommendation paper matches the breach count in the monitoring pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recommendation paper filed with the quarter it relates to and the decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recommendations widening appetite or raising a limit logged as CUO exceptions with outcomes.
generic.Test population: All breaches reported in the quarterly monitoring pack for the assumed portfolio.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any recommendation widening appetite proceeds without a recorded CUO approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Head of Reinsurance routes appetite-widening or limit-raising recommendations to the CUO.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Paper listing each breach, proposed action and quantified premium and net-PML impact.
generic.Evidence location: Excel recommendation workbook and the filed quarterly recommendation paper.

steps.title: Extract the quarter breach list from the Power BI monitoring pack
sop: Pull every appetite and accumulation limit breach reported during the quarter.
Record the size of each breach and how long it remained open.
Attribute each breach to the class, zone or cedant driving it.
Done when every quarter breach is listed with size, duration and driver.
verify: Compare the extracted list count with the monitoring pack breach count.
Pass when the breach counts agree between the pack and the recommendation list.

steps.title: Assign a proposed action to each breach in the Excel recommendation workbook
sop: State for each breach whether to reduce lines, buy retro or seek a limit increase.
Note any breach where no action is proposed and give the reason.
Keep one action per breach so accountability stays clear.
Done when every breach carries a proposed action or a stated no-action reason.
verify: Check no breach row has a blank action field.
Pass when every breach has a proposed action or documented no-action reason.

steps.title: Quantify the net-PML effect of each recommended adjustment
sop: Model the net-PML position before and after each proposed adjustment.
State the change at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods for the affected zone.
Flag any adjustment that does not bring the zone back inside tolerance.
Done when each recommended adjustment shows its net-PML effect by zone.
verify: Check the post-adjustment figures against the appetite tolerance for the zone.
Pass when each adjustment states whether it restores the zone to within tolerance.

steps.title: Quantify the premium effect of each recommended adjustment
sop: Estimate the premium given up or gained by each proposed adjustment.
Show the effect on plan premium for the remaining year.
Show the retro cost where buying retro is the proposed action.
Done when every adjustment shows its premium and cost effect.
verify: Check the premium effects sum to a stated total for the paper.
Pass when the individual premium effects reconcile to the stated total.

steps.title: Route appetite-widening recommendations to the CUO as documented exceptions
sop: Identify every recommendation that widens appetite or raises an approved limit.
Raise each as a documented exception with the quantified impact attached.
Hold the recommendation as not adopted until the CUO decision is recorded.
Done when every appetite-widening recommendation is raised as a CUO exception.
verify: Compare the exception list with the recommendations marked as widening appetite.
Pass when no appetite-widening recommendation is missing from the exception list.

steps.title: Record the decision outcome and date against each recommendation
sop: Record accept, reject or defer against each recommendation with the decision date.
Record any conditions attached to an accepted recommendation.
File the completed paper against the quarter it relates to.
Done when every recommendation carries a decision outcome and date.
verify: Read the filed paper for recommendations left without an outcome.
Pass when no recommendation in the filed paper is left undecided.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every cedant on the approved counterparty panel plus any cedant proposed for addition.
generic.In-scope period: The current review cycle, using the latest published ratings and solvency returns.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Financial-strength rating, solvency ratio, tier and eligibility outcome populated per cedant.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Panel cedant count after review equals count before review plus additions less removals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Criteria and tier assignments stored with the review date and rating as-at dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cedants failing a threshold but retained logged with the approval and rationale.
generic.Test population: All panel cedants tested against rating, solvency, data quality and claims-notification criteria.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a cedant is marked eligible while appearing on the no-write list.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Credit and Security Analyst refers retained sub-threshold cedants to the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current eligibility criteria and a tier assignment held for every panel cedant.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system counterparty records plus the filed criteria review document.

steps.title: Pull the current panel and tier assignments from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract every cedant on the approved panel with its current tier and last review date.
Flag any cedant whose assessment has passed its review due date.
Record the extract date so the review population is fixed.
Done when the full panel population is extracted with tier and last review date.
verify: Compare the extract count with the count of active panel cedants in the system.
Pass when the extract covers every active panel cedant.

steps.title: Re-test each cedant against rating and solvency thresholds
sop: Record the latest financial-strength rating, agency and rating action date for each cedant.
Record the latest solvency or capital coverage ratio and its reporting date.
Mark each cedant pass or fail against the minimum thresholds for its tier.
Done when every panel cedant is marked pass or fail on rating and solvency.
verify: Check no cedant row is left without a rating date or solvency reporting date.
Pass when every cedant carries a dated rating and solvency figure.

steps.title: Refresh tier assignments where rating, solvency or ownership has changed
sop: Identify cedants whose rating, solvency ratio or ownership changed since last review.
Reassign the tier where the change crosses a tier threshold.
Record the old tier, new tier and the reason for the change.
Done when every changed cedant has a refreshed tier with a recorded reason.
verify: Check each tier change carries a recorded reason and effective date.
Pass when no tier change is recorded without a reason and effective date.

steps.title: Confirm criteria cover data quality and claims-notification track record
sop: Review the criteria set for coverage of cedant data quality and notification timeliness.
Add or update the operational criteria where they are absent or too vague to apply.
Score each panel cedant against the operational criteria as well as financial strength.
Done when every cedant carries an operational as well as a financial assessment.
verify: Check the criteria document contains explicit data quality and notification tests.
Pass when both operational criteria appear in the current criteria set.

steps.title: Record panel additions and removals with reason and effective date
sop: Add approved new cedants to the panel with tier and effective date.
Remove cedants that failed the criteria and record the removal reason.
Keep the superseded assessment as history rather than deleting it.
Done when every addition and removal is recorded with reason and effective date.
verify: Reconcile opening panel count plus additions less removals to the closing count.
Pass when the panel count reconciliation agrees exactly.

steps.title: Update the no-write list and notify underwriters before the next renewal round
sop: Add newly excluded cedants to the no-write list in the document management repository.
Check no cedant appears as eligible on the panel and on the no-write list at once.
Notify assumed underwriters of the changes before the next renewal round opens.
Done when the no-write list is updated and underwriters are notified.
verify: Cross-match the eligible panel list against the no-write list.
Pass when no cedant appears on both the eligible panel and the no-write list.

generic.Defined scope/population: All perils and peak zones for the assumed book plus any-one-risk and any-one-programme limits.
generic.In-scope period: The plan year the limits are effective for, aligned to the retrocession programme period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gross limit, net limit, peril, zone, return period and effective date populated per limit.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Limits loaded into the accumulation system equal the limits approved in the register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Limits register entries stored with basis, approver and effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any limit set above the modelled tolerance logged with the approving authority and rationale.
generic.Test population: Every peril and peak zone limit plus the any-one-risk and any-one-programme limits.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a limit is active in the accumulation system without a register entry and approver.
generic.Exception handling path: Catastrophe and Exposure Manager refers limits above modelled tolerance to the Head of Reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved per-peril and per-zone limits loaded and effective-dated with a named approver.
generic.Evidence location: Moody's RMS accumulation configuration plus the Excel limits register for the plan year.

steps.title: Set gross and net line limits for any one risk and any one programme
sop: Set the maximum gross line for any one risk and for any one programme.
Set the corresponding net limits after the planned retrocession structure.
Express each limit in the currency and basis used at submission.
Done when gross and net limits exist for any one risk and any one programme.
verify: Check each limit has both a gross and a net figure stated.
Pass when no limit is recorded gross only.

steps.title: Set per-peril and per-zone occurrence limits at 1-in-100 and 1-in-250
sop: Set the occurrence limit for each peril and peak zone at the 1-in-100 return period.
Set the equivalent limit at the 1-in-250 return period.
Use the approved model version and record it against the limit basis.
Done when every peril and zone has limits at both return periods.
verify: Check every peak zone appears with both return-period limits.
Pass when no peak zone is missing a limit at either return period.

steps.title: Test the limits against the modelled plan position in Moody's RMS
sop: Run the plan exposure through the model and compare the position with each proposed limit.
Identify limits that the plan book would breach at inception.
Adjust the limit or flag the plan for reduction where a breach is structural.
Done when every proposed limit has been tested against the modelled plan position.
verify: Read the test output for zones where the plan position exceeds the proposed limit.
Pass when every such zone is either adjusted or flagged for referral.

steps.title: Confirm each limit is expressed net of the planned retrocession structure
sop: Apply the planned retro structure to each gross limit in the Excel limits workbook.
Record the resulting net limit alongside the gross limit for each peril and zone.
Check the inuring order used matches the retro schedule.
Done when every gross limit has a matching net limit derived from the retro structure.
verify: Recompute one zone net limit manually from the retro structure.
Pass when the manual net limit matches the workbook net limit for that zone.

steps.title: Load the approved limits into the accumulation system for automatic breach flagging
sop: Load each approved limit into the accumulation system with its peril, zone and return period.
Enable automatic breach flagging at submission against each loaded limit.
Test one submission through the check to prove the flag fires.
Done when every approved limit is loaded and breach flagging is proven to fire.
verify: Compare the loaded limit set with the approved limit list.
Pass when the loaded limits match the approved list with no limit missing.

steps.title: Record basis, effective date and approver in the limits register
sop: Record the setting basis, model version and effective date for each limit.
Record the approving authority against each gross and net limit.
Retire the prior-year limit entries and mark them superseded.
Done when every active limit has a register entry with basis, date and approver.
verify: Compare the register entries with the limits loaded in the accumulation system.
Pass when every loaded limit has a register entry naming its approver and basis.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every appetite statement that must become a machine-checkable underwriting guideline parameter.
generic.In-scope period: The plan year covered by the current signed appetite document version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class code, territory code, maximum line and minimum rate-on-line populated per parameter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parameter count in the workstation equals the appetite statement count it was derived from.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Parameter set published with version number and effective date in the repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Appetite statements that cannot be automated logged with the manual control that replaces them.
generic.Test population: All configured guideline parameters and referral triggers in the underwriting workstation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an excluded class is configured as a soft warning rather than a hard block.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager approves any parameter that cannot mirror the appetite statement exactly.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Effective-dated parameter set with a referral trigger configured for every appetite rule.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation configuration plus the published parameter document in the repository.

steps.title: Convert each appetite statement into a parameter row in the guideline workbook
sop: List every statement in the signed appetite document as a separate row.
Express each as class code, territory code, maximum line and minimum rate-on-line.
Mark any statement that cannot be expressed numerically for manual control.
Done when every appetite statement has a parameter row or a manual-control marker.
verify: Compare the parameter row count with the appetite statement count.
Pass when every appetite statement maps to a parameter row or a recorded manual control.

steps.title: Configure the parameters in the underwriting workstation
sop: Enter each parameter into the workstation guideline configuration.
Set the class and territory codes to the values used on live submissions.
Set the maximum line and minimum rate-on-line values per class.
Done when every parameter row is configured in the workstation.
verify: Export the configured parameter list and compare with the workbook.
Pass when the configured list matches the workbook parameter rows exactly.

steps.title: Configure referral triggers for every parameter breach
sop: Set a referral trigger against each parameter so a breach routes automatically.
Set the escalation level for each trigger from the authority matrix.
Remove reliance on manual judgement for any breach that can be detected by the system.
Done when every parameter carries an automatic referral trigger and escalation level.
verify: Check each configured parameter has an associated trigger and escalation level.
Pass when no parameter is configured without a referral trigger.

steps.title: Set excluded classes as hard blocks in the workstation
sop: Configure each excluded and prohibited class as a hard block on submission.
Check no excluded class is left configured as a warning that can be overridden.
Record which role, if any, may lift a block and under what approval.
Done when every excluded class is configured as a hard block.
verify: Attempt to progress a test submission on an excluded class.
Pass when the test submission is blocked rather than warned.

steps.title: Walk a live submission through the workstation to prove referrals fire
sop: Select a live submission that breaches at least one configured parameter.
Run it through the workstation and observe which referrals fire.
Record the expected and actual referral outcomes side by side.
Done when the test submission produces the expected referral outcomes.
verify: Compare the fired referrals with the expected referral list.
Pass when every expected referral fired and no unexpected referral fired.

steps.title: Publish the parameter version and effective date to the underwriting team
sop: Publish the parameter set with its version number and effective date in the repository.
Notify the assumed underwriting team that the version is live.
Supersede the prior parameter version and record its retirement date.
Done when the versioned parameter set is published and the team is notified.
verify: Check the repository for more than one active parameter version.
Pass when exactly one parameter version is marked active with an effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The cedant five-year premium and loss triangles for the classes covered by the treaty being quoted.
generic.In-scope period: The five underwriting or accident years supplied in the cedant submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, paid, incurred, development period and large-loss detail populated in every triangle.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Triangle diagonal totals tie to the summary statistics quoted in the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: As-if experience workbook stored with data as-at date and selection rationale.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Incomplete or inconsistent years logged with the treatment applied in the as-if experience.
generic.Test population: All five supplied years for the layer being quoted, including partial current-year data.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any triangle fails to tie to the submission summary statistics.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary raises triangle inconsistencies to the underwriter as a broker data request.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Five-year as-if triangles with documented development factor and trend selections.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modeling platform experience run plus the Excel as-if workbook for the treaty.

steps.title: Load the cedant premium and loss triangles into the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Load the five-year premium and loss triangles supplied in the submission.
Record the data as-at date and the basis, underwriting year or accident year.
Check each triangle diagonal ties to the summary statistics in the submission letter.
Done when all triangles are loaded and tied to the submission summary.
verify: Recompute the latest diagonal total and compare with the submission summary.
Pass when each triangle diagonal agrees with the submission summary statistics.

steps.title: Restate historical losses to current terms in the Excel as-if workbook
sop: Apply the agreed rate change index to bring historical premium onto current terms.
Apply claims inflation and exposure trend indices to historical losses.
Record the index source and value used for each year.
Done when every historical year is restated to current terms with indices recorded.
verify: Recompute one year of restatement independently.
Pass when the independent restatement matches the workbook for the tested year.

steps.title: Select development factors to ultimate and document the basis
sop: Calculate link ratios from the triangle for each development period.
Select the factor to ultimate for each year and state whether it is cedant or benchmark based.
Document the reason for any selection that departs from the mechanical average.
Done when every year has a selected development factor with a documented basis.
verify: Check each selected factor carries a written basis.
Pass when no development factor selection is left without a documented basis.

steps.title: Identify and list large losses above the layer attachment
sop: Extract every individual loss above the layer attachment from the submission listing.
Reconcile the large-loss listing to the triangles so losses are not counted twice.
Record the date, amount and status of each large loss.
Done when the large-loss list is complete and reconciled to the triangles.
verify: Compare the large-loss total with the amount included in the triangles.
Pass when the large-loss listing reconciles to the triangle amounts.

steps.title: Produce the as-if experience for the quoted layer
sop: Apply the layer attachment and limit to the restated and developed loss history.
Produce the as-if loss cost to the layer for each year.
State the treatment applied to any incomplete year in the history.
Done when as-if layer experience exists for all five years.
verify: Check the incomplete-year treatment is stated and applied consistently.
Pass when every year has an as-if layer figure and the incomplete-year treatment is documented.

steps.title: File the experience analysis against the treaty in the data warehouse extract record
sop: Store the as-if workbook and platform run reference against the treaty submission.
Record the data as-at date and index versions used.
Note the residual data limitations to carry into pricing.
Done when the analysis is filed with run reference, as-at date and limitations.
verify: Open the filed analysis and check the run reference and as-at date are present.
Pass when the filed analysis can be reproduced from the recorded references.

generic.Defined scope/population: The cedant legal entity being assessed together with its parent group where relevant.
generic.In-scope period: The latest published rating action and the latest reported solvency period for the cedant.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rating, agency, outlook, rating date, solvency ratio and reporting date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Solvency figures captured agree with the cedant published regulatory return totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment stored with the source documents and the assessment date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or stale rating and solvency data logged with the interim treatment applied.
generic.Test population: Rating, solvency, reserve development and regulatory disclosures for the cedant entity.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the assigned counterparty tier is not supported by the recorded rating and solvency.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Credit and Security Analyst refers unrated or sub-threshold cedants to the underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written assessment supporting the assigned tier with current rating and solvency recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system counterparty record plus the filed assessment in the repository.

steps.title: Capture the cedant rating and outlook in the Excel assessment workbook
sop: Record the current financial-strength rating, the agency and the outlook.
Record the date of the last rating action and any rating watch status.
Note where the rating sits on the parent rather than the writing entity.
Done when rating, agency, outlook and rating date are captured for the entity.
verify: Check the rating date is within the acceptable staleness window.
Pass when the recorded rating action date is current for the review.

steps.title: Capture the latest solvency and capital coverage ratio
sop: Record the latest reported solvency or capital coverage ratio for the cedant.
Record the reporting period the ratio relates to and the source document.
Note any material movement from the prior reported period.
Done when the solvency ratio and its reporting date are captured with a source.
verify: Trace the captured ratio back to the cedant published return.
Pass when the captured ratio agrees with the published source document.

steps.title: Review three-year reserve development history for adverse trends
sop: Review reported reserve development over the last three financial years.
Identify whether adverse development has been consistent or one-off.
Note the classes driving any adverse development.
Done when the three-year development pattern is documented with drivers.
verify: Check the development review covers all three years with figures.
Pass when the review states development for each of the three years.

steps.title: Note regulatory actions, ownership changes and run-off portfolios
sop: Search for regulatory action, sanction or licence change since the last assessment.
Record any ownership change or portfolio placed into run-off.
State the effect of each event on the counterparty view.
Done when every disclosed event since last assessment is recorded with its effect.
verify: Compare the events recorded with the period since the last assessment date.
Pass when the search covers the full period since the previous assessment.

steps.title: Assign the counterparty tier and test it against the contemplated line size
sop: Assign the counterparty tier from the rating, solvency and operational findings.
State whether the tier supports the line size being contemplated.
Raise a referral where the tier does not support the contemplated line.
Done when a tier is assigned with a stated view on the contemplated line size.
verify: Check the assigned tier against the tier criteria thresholds.
Pass when the assigned tier is consistent with the recorded rating and solvency.

steps.title: File the assessment against the cedant in the administration system
sop: Save the written assessment against the cedant counterparty record.
Attach the rating and solvency source documents from the repository.
Record the assessment date and the next review due date.
Done when the assessment is filed with sources and a next review date.
verify: Open the counterparty record and check the assessment and sources are attached.
Pass when the filed assessment carries its date, tier and supporting sources.

generic.Defined scope/population: The cedant subject premium split by line of business and territory for the treaty offered.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period being quoted, using the latest submitted subject premium estimate.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line of business, territory, premium share and appetite outcome populated per segment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Segment premium shares sum to the total subject premium quoted in the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mix assessment filed with the appetite document version referenced.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Out-of-appetite segments logged with a carve-out, referral or decline decision.
generic.Test population: Every material line of business and territory segment in the cedant subject premium.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where prohibited-class exposure remains in treaty scope without a documented carve-out.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter refers out-of-appetite segments before terms are offered.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premium split by LOB and territory mapped against the current appetite version.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation treaty file plus the Excel mix assessment workbook.

steps.title: Break the subject premium down by line of business in the Excel mix workbook
sop: Split the cedant subject premium by line of business from the submission data.
Express each line as a percentage of the total subject premium.
Check the split sums to the total subject premium quoted.
Done when the premium split by line of business is complete and sums to the total.
verify: Add the line-of-business shares and compare with the stated subject premium.
Pass when the shares reconcile to the total subject premium.

steps.title: Break the subject premium down by territory
sop: Split the subject premium by territory using the cedant exposure or premium detail.
Express each territory as a percentage of the total.
Flag any premium that cannot be allocated to a territory.
Done when the territory split is complete with unallocated premium flagged.
verify: Check unallocated premium is shown separately rather than spread.
Pass when unallocated premium is disclosed as its own line.

steps.title: Map each material segment to the appetite table in the underwriting workstation
sop: Match each material line and territory segment to the current appetite table.
Mark each segment in-appetite, out-of-appetite or referral.
Record the appetite document version used for the mapping.
Done when every material segment carries an appetite outcome.
verify: Check no material segment is left unmapped.
Pass when every material segment has an appetite outcome recorded.

steps.title: Quantify premium sitting in excluded or prohibited classes
sop: Identify premium falling in excluded or prohibited classes.
Quantify that premium as an amount and as a share of the subject premium.
Confirm whether the treaty wording carves the exposure out.
Done when prohibited-class premium is quantified and its carve-out status stated.
verify: Read the carve-out status for each prohibited-class segment.
Pass when no prohibited-class premium is left inside scope without a carve-out.

steps.title: Check underlying territorial scope against the treaty territorial clause
sop: Compare the territories in the underlying book with the treaty territorial clause offered.
Identify any territory written by the cedant but not intended to be covered.
Raise a wording change or referral where the clause and book disagree.
Done when the territorial clause is confirmed consistent with the underlying book.
verify: List territories in the book that are absent from the clause.
Pass when no territory in the book falls outside the clause without a decision.

steps.title: Record the mix assessment conclusion on the treaty file
sop: Write the mix conclusion stating in-appetite share and out-of-appetite share.
Reference the appetite version used and any referrals raised.
File the conclusion against the treaty reference in the workstation.
Done when the conclusion is filed with appetite version and referral references.
verify: Open the treaty file and check the conclusion and appetite version are present.
Pass when the filed conclusion names the appetite version it was assessed against.

generic.Defined scope/population: The agreed sample of cedant underwriting and claims files covered by the audit scope.
generic.In-scope period: The period agreed in the audit scope letter, normally since the last cedant audit.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Sample reference, test performed, outcome, finding severity and agreed action populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Files tested equal the agreed sample size stated in the scope letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audit note filed with visit date, scope, sample size and findings.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each finding logged with severity, agreed cedant action, owner and due date.
generic.Test population: The sampled underwriting files and claims files at the cedant for the agreed period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any finding is recorded without an agreed action, owner and due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter escalates severe findings to the Reinsurance Manager before terms are released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated audit note with scope, sample size and findings each carrying an agreed action.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository cedant audit folder linked to the treaty record.

steps.title: Agree the audit scope and sample basis with the cedant in writing
sop: Draft the scope letter stating period, classes, sample basis and sample size.
Send it to the cedant by email and obtain written agreement before the visit.
File the agreed scope letter in the repository against the treaty.
Done when the cedant has agreed the scope and sample basis in writing.
verify: Check the filed scope letter carries the cedant written agreement.
Pass when written cedant agreement to the scope predates the audit date.

steps.title: Select the underwriting and claims file samples
sop: Select the underwriting file sample on the agreed basis across the audit period.
Select the claims file sample covering open and closed claims.
Record each sampled file reference before testing starts.
Done when both samples are selected and recorded at the agreed sizes.
verify: Count the selected files against the agreed sample sizes.
Pass when the selected sample counts equal the agreed sample sizes.

steps.title: Test the underwriting file sample against the cedant own guidelines
sop: Test each sampled file for authority evidence, pricing basis and referral compliance.
Record pass or fail per test per file with a note on any failure.
Note any pattern of failure across the sample rather than individual cases only.
Done when every sampled underwriting file has recorded test outcomes.
verify: Check no sampled file is left without a test outcome.
Pass when every sampled underwriting file carries a recorded outcome.

steps.title: Test the claims file sample for reserving adequacy and notification timeliness
sop: Compare initial case reserves with settled or current amounts on the sampled claims.
Check notification dates against the treaty loss-advice threshold and deadlines.
Record any late notification or material reserve inadequacy as a finding.
Done when every sampled claims file has reserving and notification outcomes.
verify: Check the notification test used the treaty thresholds in force for the period.
Pass when the notification test references the correct treaty threshold.

steps.title: Record each finding with severity, agreed action and due date
sop: Record each finding with a severity rating and the evidence supporting it.
Agree the cedant action, owner and due date for each finding during the meeting.
Escalate severe findings internally before terms are released.
Done when every finding has severity, agreed action, owner and due date.
verify: Read the finding log for blanks in action, owner or due date.
Pass when no finding is left without an agreed action, owner and due date.

steps.title: Issue the audit note to the cedant and file it against the treaty record
sop: Issue the audit note by email to the cedant with the findings and agreed actions.
File the note and the cedant response in the repository against the treaty.
Confirm the note is filed before renewal terms are released.
Done when the audit note is issued and filed against the treaty record.
verify: Check the file date of the audit note against the terms release date.
Pass when the audit note is filed before renewal terms were released.

generic.Defined scope/population: The treaty being assessed with its rating outputs, cedant findings and recommended terms.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period being quoted and the experience period the rating draws on.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Risk drivers, rating references, recommended terms and conditions precedent populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rating output versions cited in the write-up match those held on the treaty file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment stored in the workstation with peer reviewer name and review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Differences between cedant requested terms and recommended terms logged with rationale.
generic.Test population: All risk drivers, rating references and recommended terms in the assessment write-up.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the assessment reaches authorization without a recorded peer review.
generic.Exception handling path: Peer reviewer returns the assessment to the underwriter where the rationale is not reproducible.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Write-up with risk drivers, versioned rating references and recommended terms plus peer review.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation treaty file with the assessment stored in the repository.

steps.title: State the key risk drivers for the treaty in the workstation assessment
sop: Set out exposure growth, rate change, loss trend and cat exposure for the treaty.
State the evidence behind each driver rather than asserting it.
Note which drivers most affect the recommended price.
Done when every key risk driver is stated with its supporting evidence.
verify: Check each stated driver cites evidence from the submission or analysis.
Pass when no risk driver is stated without supporting evidence.

steps.title: Reference the experience and exposure rating outputs by version
sop: Cite the experience rating run reference and its data as-at date.
Cite the exposure rating run reference, curve selection and model version.
Confirm the cited runs are the ones held on the treaty file.
Done when both rating outputs are cited by version and as-at date.
verify: Open one cited run from the treaty file using the reference given.
Pass when the cited run reference retrieves the output held on file.

steps.title: State the recommended terms, line and conditions precedent
sop: State the recommended structure, price, line and period explicitly.
List every condition precedent to binding.
Express monetary values so they cannot be read ambiguously.
Done when recommended terms, line and conditions precedent are all stated.
verify: Check the recommended line is within the underwriter authority for the class.
Pass when the recommended line sits inside authority or carries a referral reference.

steps.title: Record differences between cedant requested and recommended terms
sop: List the terms the cedant requested alongside the terms recommended.
State the reason for each difference.
Flag the differences most likely to be contested in negotiation.
Done when every material difference is listed with a reason.
verify: Compare the difference list with the submission requested terms.
Pass when every material requested term is addressed in the difference list.

steps.title: Obtain peer review sign-off on the assessment
sop: Route the completed assessment for peer review before authorization.
Record the peer reviewer name, date and any changes required.
Make the required changes before the assessment moves forward.
Done when peer review sign-off is recorded on the assessment.
verify: Check the peer review date precedes the authorization request date.
Pass when peer review sign-off predates the authorization step.

steps.title: File the assessment in the document management repository against the treaty
sop: File the signed-off assessment against the treaty reference.
Attach the rating outputs and cedant findings referenced in the write-up.
Confirm the filed version is the peer-reviewed version.
Done when the peer-reviewed assessment is filed with its attachments.
verify: Open the filed assessment and confirm the peer review record is present.
Pass when the filed assessment shows the peer reviewer name and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The cedant claims handling operation and underwriting control framework for the classes reinsured.
generic.In-scope period: The claims and underwriting periods covered by the sampled files and cedant disclosures.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claims philosophy, reserving basis, authority levels and sample outcomes populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sampled closed claims tested equal the sample size stated in the evaluation.

generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter escalates material weaknesses before terms are quoted.

generic.Evidence location: Document management repository cedant file plus the Excel sample testing workbook.

steps.title: Review the cedant claims philosophy and reserving basis from the submission pack

Record the reserving basis used and the authority levels held by claims staff.
Note any use of third-party administrators or delegated claims handling.
Done when philosophy, reserving basis and claims authority levels are recorded.
verify: Check the recorded basis cites the cedant document it came from.
Pass when each recorded element cites its source document.

steps.title: Test case reserve adequacy on a closed-claims sample in Excel

Compare the initial case reserve with the final settled amount for each claim.
Summarise the average and spread of reserve adequacy across the sample.
Done when reserve adequacy is measured across the closed-claims sample.
verify: Recompute the adequacy ratio for two sampled claims.
Pass when the recomputed ratios match the workbook results.

steps.title: Check the notification track record against the treaty loss-advice threshold
