Count late notifications and quantify the average delay.
Record any notification failure that affected a prior recovery.
Done when the notification track record is quantified against the treaty terms.
verify: Check the threshold used matches the treaty in force for the period tested.
Pass when the notification test uses the correct in-force threshold.

steps.title: Assess the cedant underwriting guidelines for rating and referral discipline
sop: Review the cedant guidelines for rating basis, referral triggers and authority limits.
Assess the oversight applied to any delegated underwriting authority.
Record where the guidelines are silent or unenforceable in practice.
Done when guideline strengths and gaps are recorded with examples.
verify: Check each recorded gap references the guideline section it relates to.
Pass when every recorded gap cites the relevant guideline section.

steps.title: Record the quality conclusion and the treaty conditions required
sop: Write the overall claims and underwriting quality conclusion.
State the treaty conditions needed to mitigate each weakness found.
Flag any weakness serious enough to decline rather than condition.
Done when the conclusion is written and each weakness has a proposed condition.
verify: Match the condition list against the weakness list.
Pass when every identified weakness has a proposed treaty condition or a decline recommendation.

steps.title: File the evaluation and sample evidence in the repository
sop: File the evaluation with the sample testing workbook against the cedant record.
Record the evaluation date and the sample sizes used.
Link the evaluation to the treaty being quoted.
Done when the evaluation and its sample evidence are filed and linked.
verify: Open the filed evaluation and confirm the sample evidence is attached.
Pass when the filed evaluation includes its supporting sample evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every term offered on the treaty including structure, exclusions, scope, period and pricing.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period of cover being evaluated against the current appetite version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attachment, limit, reinstatements, exclusions, territory, period and price populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Terms compared equal the terms listed on the slip presented by the broker.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Term-by-term comparison stored on the treaty file with the appetite version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each out-of-appetite term logged with a referral reference and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All structural, exclusion, scope and pricing terms offered on the treaty.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an out-of-appetite term is accepted without a corresponding referral record.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter raises a referral for every parameter outside appetite.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Term-by-term appetite comparison recorded on the treaty file with referral references.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation treaty file with the wording held in the treaty repository.

steps.title: Compare structure, attachment, limit and reinstatements with the appetite parameters
sop: List the offered structure, attachment, limit and reinstatement provisions.
Compare each against the appetite parameter table in the workstation.
Mark each term in-appetite or out-of-appetite.
Done when every structural term is marked against the appetite parameters.
verify: Check no structural term is left unmarked.
Pass when every structural term carries an appetite outcome.

steps.title: Check the offered exclusions against the mandated clause set
sop: Retrieve the mandated clause set for the class from the treaty repository.
Compare the offered cyber, terrorism, communicable disease and sanctions exclusions.
List any mandated exclusion that is absent or weakened.
Done when every mandated exclusion is confirmed present or listed as missing.
verify: Check the mandated clause set used is the current version.
Pass when the comparison cites the current mandated clause set version.

steps.title: Confirm territorial scope and period fall inside approved appetite
sop: Compare the offered territorial scope with the approved territory list.
Compare the period of cover with the approved maximum period.
Flag multi-year or continuous terms that need specific approval.
Done when territorial scope and period are confirmed inside appetite or flagged.
verify: Check any territory outside the approved list is flagged rather than accepted.
Pass when no out-of-scope territory is accepted without a flag.

steps.title: Confirm ceding commission or rate-on-line is within the class benchmark
sop: Retrieve the class benchmark commission ceiling or minimum rate-on-line.
Compare the offered pricing term with the benchmark.
Quantify any shortfall against the benchmark in points or percentage.
Done when the pricing term is compared with the benchmark and any shortfall is quantified.
verify: Check the benchmark version used is the current plan-year set.
Pass when the comparison uses the current plan-year benchmark version.

steps.title: Raise a referral for every parameter outside appetite
sop: Raise a referral in the workstation for each out-of-appetite term identified.
State the parameter, the appetite limit and the extent of the deviation.
Hold acceptance of the term until the referral decision is recorded.
Done when every out-of-appetite term has an open or decided referral.
verify: Match the referral list against the out-of-appetite term list.
Pass when no out-of-appetite term is missing a referral record.

steps.title: Record the term-by-term comparison on the treaty file
sop: Save the completed comparison against the treaty reference.
Cite the appetite document version used for the assessment.
Link each referral reference to the term it relates to.
Done when the comparison is filed with appetite version and referral links.
verify: Open the filed comparison and check the appetite version is cited.
Pass when the filed comparison names its appetite version and referral links.

generic.Defined scope/population: The treaty referral being presented with its cedant assessment, rating and accumulation impact.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period being quoted, presented before authorization is sought.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Referral trigger, recommendation, options considered and accumulation impact populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pack figures agree with the rating output and accumulation run held on the treaty file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral pack filed with presentation date and the CUO decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conditions attached by the CUO logged so they can be checked at binding.
generic.Test population: The referral pack contents and the CUO decision record for the treaty.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where authorization proceeds without a recorded CUO decision and date.
generic.Exception handling path: Chief Underwriting Officer may accept with conditions, decline or send back for more analysis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral pack naming the trigger, recommendation and options with a dated CUO decision.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository referral folder linked to the treaty record.

steps.title: Assemble the referral pack in the document management repository
sop: Bring together the cedant assessment, rating output, accumulation impact and recommended line.
Check each component is the current version held on the treaty file.
Keep the pack to the decision-relevant content.
Done when the pack contains assessment, rating, accumulation impact and recommended line.
verify: Compare pack figures with the rating and accumulation outputs on file.
Pass when pack figures agree with the source outputs on the treaty file.

steps.title: State the authority breach or referral trigger requiring the CUO decision
sop: Name the specific threshold or trigger that puts the treaty outside standard authority.
Quote the authority matrix version and the limit being exceeded.
State the size of the excess.
Done when the referral trigger and the size of the excess are stated in the pack.
verify: Check the quoted limit against the current authority matrix.
Pass when the quoted limit matches the current authority matrix version.

steps.title: Include the underwriter recommendation and alternatives considered
sop: State the recommended course of action clearly rather than presenting facts alone.
List the alternatives considered and why each was not preferred.
State the consequence of declining the treaty.
Done when the pack carries a recommendation and the alternatives considered.
verify: Check the pack contains at least one alternative alongside the recommendation.
Pass when the pack presents a recommendation and at least one alternative.

steps.title: Present the pack to the CUO over Microsoft Teams
sop: Present the referral with the trigger, recommendation and accumulation impact.
Answer questions on cedant quality and pricing adequacy.
Note any further analysis the CUO asks for before deciding.
Done when the referral has been presented and questions answered.
verify: Check any requested further analysis is recorded with an owner.
Pass when every request made in the session has a recorded owner.

steps.title: Capture the CUO decision, conditions and date
sop: Record the decision as accept, accept with conditions or decline.
State every condition attached to an acceptance.
Record the decision date.
Done when the decision, conditions and date are recorded.
verify: Read the decision record for missing conditions or date.
Pass when the decision record carries the outcome, conditions and date.

steps.title: File the decision against the treaty record so it is visible at binding
sop: File the referral pack and decision against the treaty reference.
Link the decision to the authorization step so binding cannot bypass it.
Confirm the conditions are carried into the binding checklist.
Done when the decision is filed and linked to the authorization record.
verify: Open the treaty record and check the decision is visible from the binding view.
Pass when the CUO decision is retrievable from the treaty record before binding.

generic.Defined scope/population: The specific treaty layer being quoted with its attachment, limit and reinstatement terms.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period being rated using the as-if experience period supplied.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attachment, limit, as-if loss cost, severity curve and credibility weight populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: As-if loss cost used ties to the experience analysis output for the same layer.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating run stored with model version, curve reference and data as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Technical price shortfalls against the class minimum logged and flagged to the underwriter.
generic.Test population: The quoted layer rated on both experience and exposure bases.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the technical rate-on-line is not compared with the class minimum benchmark.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary flags any technical price below the class minimum for underwriter referral.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Experience and exposure indications with credibility weighting and technical rate-on-line.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modeling platform rating run plus the Excel layer pricing workbook.

steps.title: Run the burning-cost experience rating for the layer in the actuarial platform
sop: Apply the layer attachment and limit to the as-if loss history.
Calculate the burning cost and the experience loss cost to the layer.
Record the years used and any year excluded with the reason.
Done when the experience indication for the layer is produced.
verify: Compare the as-if loss cost input with the experience analysis output.
Pass when the loss cost used ties to the filed experience analysis.

steps.title: Run the exposure rating using the agreed severity curves
sop: Select the approved severity curve for the class and record its reference.
Apply the exposure profile to the layer to derive the exposure loss cost.
Document why the selected curve fits the underlying portfolio.
Done when the exposure indication is produced with its curve reference recorded.
verify: Check the curve reference is on the approved curve list.
Pass when the curve used appears on the approved curve list.

steps.title: Blend experience and exposure indications with a stated credibility weight
sop: Set the credibility weight between the two indications and state the basis.
Calculate the blended loss cost for the layer.
Show both underlying indications alongside the blend.
Done when the blended loss cost is produced with a stated credibility weight.
verify: Recompute the blend from the two indications and the stated weight.
Pass when the recomputed blend matches the platform output.

steps.title: Load the indication for expenses, brokerage, reinstatements and capital
sop: Add expense and brokerage loads to the blended loss cost.
Value the reinstatement provisions and reflect them in the price.
Add the cost-of-capital load to give the technical rate-on-line.
Done when the technical rate-on-line is derived from the loaded indication.
verify: Check each load applied is the current plan-year load for the class.
Pass when all loads applied come from the current plan-year benchmark set.

steps.title: Compare the technical price with the class minimum rate-on-line benchmark
sop: Retrieve the class minimum rate-on-line for the layer band.
Compare the technical rate-on-line with the minimum.
Flag any shortfall to the underwriter with its size in points.
Done when the comparison is complete and any shortfall is flagged.
verify: Check the layer band used matches the layer being rated.
Pass when the benchmark compared is for the correct layer band.

steps.title: File the rating run with model version and data as-at date
sop: Save the rating run against the treaty with its run reference.
Record the model version, curve reference and data as-at date.
Attach the Excel layer pricing workbook to the same record.
Done when the run is filed with version, curve and as-at date recorded.
verify: Retrieve the run using the recorded reference and check it reproduces the price.
Pass when the filed run reproduces the technical rate-on-line quoted.

generic.Defined scope/population: The cedant counterparty record plus its parent group linkage in the administration system.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Agency rating, rating date, internal tier, credit limit and effective date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Group aggregate exposure after linkage equals the sum of linked entity exposures.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cedants recorded without an agency rating logged with the internal assessment used instead.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a superseded rating is overwritten rather than retained as history.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Credit and Security Analyst corrects and re-saves records failing the eligibility check.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rating, tier and credit limit saved with effective date and correct group linkage.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system counterparty record in Sapiens ReinsurancePro.

steps.title: Open the cedant counterparty record in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Locate the cedant counterparty record by legal entity name and identifier.
Confirm the record is the writing entity and not a trading name.
Create the record where the cedant is new to the panel.
Done when the correct counterparty record is open for update.
verify: Check the entity identifier against the assessment document.
Pass when the record identifier matches the assessed legal entity.

steps.title: Enter agency rating, rating date and internal tier
sop: Enter the agency rating and the agency that issued it.
Enter the rating action date and the outlook.
Enter the internal tier assigned in the financial strength assessment.
Done when rating, agency, date and internal tier are saved on the record.
verify: Compare the saved values with the filed assessment.
Pass when the saved rating and tier match the filed assessment.

steps.title: Set the aggregate credit and exposure limit with its effective date
sop: Enter the aggregate credit or exposure limit agreed for the cedant.
Set the effective date and any expiry date for the limit.
Confirm the limit currency matches the reporting currency used.
Done when the credit limit is saved with effective date and currency.
verify: Check the saved limit against the approved limit in the assessment.
Pass when the saved limit equals the approved limit with an effective date.

steps.title: Link the record to the parent group in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Set the parent group link on the counterparty record.
Confirm the group hierarchy holds no duplicate entry for the same entity.
Refresh the group aggregate exposure view after linking.
Done when the record is linked to its parent group and aggregates correctly.
verify: Compare group aggregate exposure with the sum of linked entity exposures.
Pass when the group aggregate equals the sum of its linked entities.

steps.title: Retain the superseded rating as dated history
sop: Check the prior rating is retained as a history row rather than overwritten.
Confirm the history row carries its own effective and end dates.
Restore the history entry where it has been lost.
Done when the prior rating remains visible as dated history.
verify: Open the rating history view for the cedant.
Pass when the prior rating appears with its own effective dates.

steps.title: Confirm the saved record drives the submission eligibility check
sop: Run a test eligibility check for the cedant after saving.
Confirm the check reads the new rating, tier and credit limit.
Raise a system issue where the check reads stale values.
Done when the eligibility check reflects the newly saved values.
verify: Compare the values shown by the eligibility check with the saved record.
Pass when the eligibility check returns the newly saved rating, tier and limit.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full cedant submission pack for the treaty offered including all supporting exhibits.
generic.In-scope period: The submission receipt date through to the completeness conclusion for this renewal.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Guidelines, rate history, loss triangles, large-loss listing and exposure profile present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Triangle and exposure profile totals reconcile to the subject premium in the submission letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submission pack filed against the treaty reference with the receipt date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each missing or inconsistent item logged as a data gap with a broker request raised.
generic.Test population: Every item on the minimum submission pack checklist for a treaty submission.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a minimum-pack item is missing without a data-gap request to the broker.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter holds the submission until gaps are closed or accepted with limitation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission logged with a completeness review outcome and a dated receipt record.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation submission record with documents in the document repository.

steps.title: Check the minimum submission pack is present in the underwriting workstation
sop: Check for underwriting guidelines, rate history, loss triangles, large-loss listing and exposure profile.
Mark each item received or missing on the submission record.
Record the receipt date and the channel the submission arrived through.
Done when every minimum-pack item is marked received or missing.
verify: Count items marked received against the minimum-pack checklist.
Pass when every checklist item is explicitly marked received or missing.

steps.title: Reconcile the loss triangles to the submission summary statistics
sop: Total the triangle premium and loss figures for each year supplied.
Compare with the summary premium and loss quoted in the submission letter.
Record any difference and its size.
Done when the triangles are reconciled to the submission summary or differences are recorded.
verify: Recheck the reconciliation for the two most recent years.
Pass when the tested years reconcile or carry a recorded difference.

steps.title: Reconcile the exposure profile band totals to the subject premium
sop: Total the exposure profile bands supplied in the submission.
Compare the total with the stated subject premium.
Record any band with zero or implausible values.
Done when the exposure profile is reconciled to the stated subject premium.
verify: Check the band total against the subject premium figure.
Pass when the band total agrees with the subject premium or the gap is recorded.

steps.title: Review the cedant underwriting philosophy and guidelines
sop: Read the cedant underwriting philosophy and guideline document supplied.
Note the rating basis, authority structure and referral controls described.
Record any element that is missing or too vague to assess.
Done when the philosophy and guidelines are reviewed and gaps are noted.
verify: Check the review notes cite the guideline sections relied on.
Pass when the review cites specific guideline sections.

steps.title: Raise a data-gap request to the broker for every missing item
sop: List each missing or inconsistent item as a specific data gap.
State why each item is needed and the date it is needed by.
Send the request to the broker and record it on the submission.
Done when every gap has a dated request logged against the submission.
verify: Match the request list against the missing-item list.
Pass when every missing minimum-pack item has a broker request logged.

steps.title: File the submission pack against the treaty reference with receipt date
sop: File all received documents against the treaty reference in the repository.
Record the receipt date and the completeness review outcome.
Link the file to the workstation submission record.
Done when the pack is filed with receipt date and completeness outcome.
verify: Open the treaty file and check the receipt date and outcome are present.
Pass when the filed submission shows its receipt date and completeness outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assumed line on the placement being signed down, from written line to final order.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Signed lines above authority logged and referred before the record is updated.

generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter refers any over-authority signed line before confirming the order.

steps.title: Obtain the broker signing advice by email
sop: Request or receive the signing advice showing the final order percentage.
Check it names the treaty reference, period and written line it relates to.
Chase the broker where the advice is missing or incomplete.
Done when the signing advice is received showing the final order percentage.
verify: Check the advice quotes the same treaty reference as the underwriting file.
Pass when the advice reference matches the treaty on file.

steps.title: Calculate the signing-down factor from written line to final order
sop: Divide the final order percentage by the written line percentage.
Record the signing-down factor to the agreed precision.
Recalculate the resulting monetary exposure at the signed line.
Done when the signing-down factor and signed monetary exposure are calculated.
verify: Recompute signed line times treaty limit and compare with the recorded exposure.
Pass when the recomputed exposure matches the recorded monetary exposure.

steps.title: Check the signed line against the underwriter authority limit
sop: Compare the signed line and its monetary exposure with the authority limit.
Refer immediately where the signed line exceeds authority.
Hold the record update until any referral is decided.
Done when the signed line is confirmed within authority or referred.
verify: Check the authority limit used is from the current matrix version.
Pass when no signed line above authority is recorded without a referral.

steps.title: Confirm the final order applies the agreed terms without amendment
sop: Compare terms, period and premium on the advice with the authorized terms.
Query any amendment introduced at signing with the broker.
Record the outcome of any query before proceeding.
Done when the final order terms are confirmed to match the authorized terms.
verify: List any difference between advice terms and authorized terms.
Pass when no unresolved difference remains between advice and authorization.

steps.title: Update the treaty record from written line to signed line
sop: Update the administration system record with the signed line and signing-down factor.
Keep the written line visible so the signing history is preserved.
Attach the signing advice to the treaty record.
Done when the record shows signed line, factor and the attached advice.
verify: Open the treaty record and compare the signed line with the advice.
Pass when the recorded signed line equals the advice final order percentage.

steps.title: Notify technical accounting of the confirmed order
sop: Email technical accounting with the confirmed signed line and premium share.
State that premium booking must use the signed line not the written line.
Record the notification against the treaty record.
Done when technical accounting has been notified of the confirmed order.
verify: Check the notification quotes the signed line recorded in the system.
Pass when the notified signed line matches the system record.

generic.Defined scope/population: The written line agreed with the broker on the placement being confirmed.

generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter escalates any broker refusal to acknowledge the line in writing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written line confirmation sent with the broker written acknowledgement received.

steps.title: Draft the line confirmation from the authorized terms
sop: State the written line percentage, terms and effective date in the confirmation.
Quote the treaty reference used on the underwriting file.
Check the drafted line matches the authorized line exactly.
Done when the confirmation is drafted and matches the authorized line.
verify: Compare the drafted line with the authorization record.
Pass when the drafted line equals the authorized line.

steps.title: Record any verbal line agreement in writing within 24 hours
sop: Where the line was agreed verbally, note the time and party of the agreement.
Issue the written confirmation within 24 hours of that agreement.
Record both the verbal time and the written confirmation time.
Done when every verbal agreement has a written confirmation inside 24 hours.
verify: Compare the verbal agreement time with the written confirmation time.
Pass when the elapsed time between verbal and written is within 24 hours.

steps.title: Send the confirmation to the broker over Reinsurer Exchange or email
sop: Send the confirmation to the broker contact of record.
Use Reinsurer Exchange where the placement is running on the platform.
Record the send channel, date and time.
Done when the confirmation is sent and the send record is captured.
verify: Check the send record shows channel, recipient and timestamp.
Pass when the send record carries recipient and timestamp.

steps.title: Obtain the broker written acknowledgement before treating the line as firm
sop: Chase the broker for written acknowledgement of the confirmed line.
Do not treat the line as firm until acknowledgement is received.
Record each chase with its date.
Done when the broker written acknowledgement is received and recorded.
verify: Check the acknowledgement quotes the same line percentage as the confirmation.
Pass when the acknowledged line matches the confirmed line.

steps.title: Check the confirmed line against the authorized line on the file
sop: Compare the acknowledged line with the authorized line on the underwriting file.
Query any difference with the broker before it becomes a bound position.
Record the resolution of any difference.
Done when the confirmed line is reconciled to the authorized line.
verify: List any difference between confirmed and authorized lines.
Pass when no unresolved difference remains between the two.

steps.title: File the confirmation correspondence against the treaty reference
sop: File the confirmation and acknowledgement against the treaty reference.
Record the send and acknowledgement dates on the treaty file.
Confirm the filed copy is the version actually sent.
Done when the correspondence is filed with both dates recorded.
verify: Open the treaty file and check both dates are present.
Pass when the filed correspondence carries send and acknowledgement dates.

steps.title: Set the written line percentage and monetary exposure in the line sizing workbook

Convert it to the monetary limit exposure at full limit.
State the currency and the exchange rate used where relevant.
Done when written line percentage and monetary exposure are recorded.
verify: Recompute the monetary exposure from percentage and treaty limit.
Pass when the recomputed exposure matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Allow for expected signing-down to avoid an over-line

Test the position that results if the placement signs at full order.
Reduce the written line where full signing would create an over-line.

verify: Compute the exposure at full signing and compare with the per-risk limit.
Pass when exposure at full signing stays inside the per-risk limit.

steps.title: Test the line against remaining per-zone and per-peril capacity
sop: Retrieve remaining capacity for the affected perils and peak zones.
Add the contemplated line and report the post-addition position.
Include quoted-not-bound lines in the committed capacity figure.
Done when the line is tested against remaining zonal and peril capacity.
verify: Check quoted-not-bound positions are included in the committed figure.
Pass when the capacity test includes quoted-not-bound commitments.

steps.title: Test the line against remaining per-cedant capacity
sop: Retrieve the cedant aggregate limit and the exposure already committed.
Add the contemplated line and compare with the cedant limit.
Refer where the cedant limit would be exceeded.
Done when the line is tested against remaining cedant capacity.
verify: Compare committed plus contemplated exposure with the cedant limit.
Pass when the combined figure stays inside the cedant limit or a referral exists.

steps.title: Confirm the line size sits within underwriter authority
sop: Compare the line size and premium income with the authority matrix limits.
Raise a referral where either threshold is exceeded.
Record the authority clause the line is written under.
Done when the line is confirmed within authority or referred.
verify: Check the authority version cited is the current matrix.
Pass when the authority check cites the current matrix version.

steps.title: Record the line rationale and lead or follow position on the treaty file

steps.title: Identify the authority clause the line is written under

Quote the clause reference and the matrix version in the record.
Confirm the clause covers the line size actually written.

sop: Record the estimated premium income, the line size and the maximum exposure.

Mark whether each element is inside or outside authority.

steps.title: Attach referral or CUO approval references for out-of-authority elements
sop: List every element outside standard authority for this line.
Attach the referral or CUO approval reference for each.
Confirm each approval predates the binding entry.
Done when every out-of-authority element carries an approval reference.
verify: Match the approval references against the out-of-authority element list.
Pass when no out-of-authority element lacks an approval reference.

steps.title: Complete the authority record within 24 hours of the decision
sop: Save the completed authority record in the underwriting workstation.
Record the underwriting decision timestamp and the record completion timestamp.

Done when the record is saved within 24 hours of the decision.
verify: Compare the decision timestamp with the record completion timestamp.

steps.title: File the authority record against the treaty in the repository

verify: Run the bound-line list for the period and check for missing authority records.
Pass when every bound line in the period has an authority record.

steps.title: Attach pricing output and accumulation impact to the referral

steps.title: Route the referral with a written recommendation in the workflow tool

Done when the referral is routed with a written recommendation.
verify: Check the routing level against the authority matrix escalation rule.
Pass when the referral is routed to the level able to approve the breach.

steps.title: Hold the quote as unissued until the decision is recorded
sop: Set the quote status to held in the underwriting workstation.

Tell the broker the indication is subject to referral if pressed for timing.
Done when the quote is held and cannot be issued while the referral is open.
verify: Attempt to issue the held quote in the workstation.
Pass when the workstation blocks issue while the referral is open.

steps.title: Record the escalation decision and decision-maker
sop: Record approve, approve with conditions or decline against the referral.

verify: Check the decision-maker authority against the matrix for the breach level.
Pass when the decision-maker held authority for the threshold decided.

sop: Link the referral and decision to the treaty file in the workstation.
Release the quote hold only after the decision is linked.

Done when the escalation and decision are logged against the treaty.
verify: List quotes issued in the period against their referral status.
Pass when no quote was issued while its referral remained open.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assumed treaty quote being delivered to the broker for the placement.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Structure, layer, pricing, reinstatements, period and validity date populated on the quote.

steps.title: Check the quote states structure, pricing, reinstatements, period and validity

Pass when every mandated clause is present or covered by a referral.

sop: Compare the quote terms with the authorization record on the file.
List any difference between quoted and authorized terms.
Hold issue until any difference is resolved or re-authorized.
Done when quoted terms match the authorized terms.
verify: List differences between quote and authorization.

steps.title: Send the quote to the broker over Reinsurer Exchange within the turnaround standard
sop: Send the quote to the broker through Reinsurer Exchange or by email.

Record the cause where the standard is missed.

verify: Compare the issue date with the submission completeness date.
Pass when the elapsed time is within the firm-quote turnaround standard.

generic.Defined scope/population: The formal quote letter or market indication issued to the cedant or broker.

steps.title: Save the prepared quote in the underwriting workstation
sop: Save the completed quote sheet against the treaty in the workstation.
Set the status to prepared and not yet issued.
Supersede any earlier prepared version.
Done when the prepared quote is saved and earlier versions are superseded.
verify: Check the workstation for more than one active prepared quote version.
Pass when only one prepared quote version is active for the treaty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The bound treaty record covering reference, parties, terms, premium and linked references.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty inception to expiry period being booked into the administration system.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reference, cedant, broker, dates, class, territory, lines and premium basis populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entered terms reconcile line by line to the signed slip before release.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bound record linked to the underwriting file, authorization and quote references.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Differences between slip and system entry logged and corrected before release.
generic.Test population: Every field on the bound treaty record compared against the signed slip.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a bound record is released without a linked authorization reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty Specialist holds release and refers unreconciled entries to the underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Treaty booked with signed line, limit, attachment and premium basis matching the slip.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system treaty record held in Sapiens ReinsurancePro.

steps.title: Create the treaty record with reference, parties, dates, class and territory
sop: Create the record and allocate the treaty reference.
Enter cedant, broker, inception, expiry, class and territory.
Check the cedant is the counterparty record assessed and approved.
Done when the treaty header is created with all identifying fields.
verify: Compare the header fields with the signed slip.
Pass when every header field matches the slip.

steps.title: Enter written line, signed line, limit, attachment and reinstatements
sop: Enter the written and signed lines exactly as authorized.
Enter limit, attachment and reinstatement terms in monetary values.
Do not round or approximate any term at entry.
Done when all line and structural terms are entered as authorized.
verify: Compare the entered structural terms with the slip.
Pass when the entered limit, attachment and lines match the slip.

steps.title: Enter premium basis, estimated premium income and instalment schedule
sop: Enter the premium basis and estimated premium income.
Enter each instalment date and amount or percentage.
Check the instalments sum to the estimated premium income.
Done when the premium basis and full instalment schedule are entered.
verify: Add the entered instalments and compare with estimated premium income.
Pass when the instalments sum to the estimated premium income.

steps.title: Reconcile the entered terms line by line to the signed slip
sop: Work through the slip term by term against the system entry.
Mark each term matched or exception.
Correct every exception before the record is released.
Done when every slip term is matched to the system entry.
verify: Read the reconciliation for unresolved exceptions.
Pass when no unresolved slip-to-system exception remains.

steps.title: Link the record to underwriting file, authorization and quote references
sop: Attach the underwriting file reference to the bound record.
Attach the authorization reference and the issued quote reference.
Confirm each link resolves to the correct document.
Done when all three references are linked and resolve correctly.
verify: Open each linked reference from the bound record.
Pass when every link resolves to the intended document.

steps.title: Release the bound record in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Release the record once reconciliation and linking are complete.
Record the release date and the releasing user.
Notify technical accounting that the record is live.
Done when the record is released with date and user recorded.
verify: Check released records in the period for missing authorization links.
Pass when no released bound record lacks its authorization reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assumed line amount for the placement including its lead or follow position.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period, using capacity remaining at the date the line is set.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lead or follow status, line percentage, monetary limit and capacity check populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Monetary limit equals the line percentage applied to the treaty limit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Line decision and rationale recorded on the underwriting file with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lead lines taken without class lead authority logged and referred.
generic.Test population: The proposed line tested against cedant, class and peak zone capacity remaining.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a lead line is taken without documented lead authority for the class.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager approves lead positions where team lead authority is not held.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Line amount recorded with lead or follow status and a capacity check reference.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation line record plus the Excel capacity check workbook.

steps.title: Decide and record the lead or follow position in the workstation
sop: Decide whether the position is lead or follow for this placement.
Record the decision and the reason on the underwriting file.
Note the wording and claims-control duties a lead line carries.
Done when the lead or follow position is recorded with a reason.
verify: Check the recorded position against the placement documentation.
Pass when the recorded position matches the placement role taken.

steps.title: Set the line amount in percentage and monetary limit terms
sop: Set the line as a percentage of the treaty.
Convert it to the monetary limit exposure in the treaty currency.
Record the exchange rate used where the currency differs from reporting.
Done when the line is recorded in both percentage and monetary terms.
verify: Recompute the monetary limit from percentage and treaty limit.
Pass when the recomputed monetary limit matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Check the line against remaining cedant and class capacity
sop: Retrieve remaining capacity for the cedant and for the class of business.
Add the contemplated line and compare with each limit.
Refer where either limit would be exceeded.
Done when the line is tested against cedant and class capacity.
verify: Compare committed plus contemplated exposure with each limit.
Pass when both limits are respected or a referral is recorded.

steps.title: Check the line against remaining peak zone capacity in the Excel capacity workbook
sop: Retrieve remaining peak zone capacity for the perils exposed.
Add the contemplated line and report the post-addition position.
Flag any zone where the line would breach the approved limit.
Done when the line is tested against peak zone capacity for all exposed perils.
verify: Check every exposed peril and zone appears in the capacity test.
Pass when no exposed peak zone is missing from the capacity test.

steps.title: Confirm lead authority is held before taking a lead line
sop: Check the authority matrix for lead authority in this class.
Refer where a lead line is proposed without that authority.
Record the authority reference supporting a lead position.
Done when lead authority is confirmed or a referral is recorded.
verify: Check the lead authority reference against the current matrix.
Pass when no lead line is set without a documented lead authority.

steps.title: Record the line decision and rationale on the underwriting file
sop: Record the final line amount, position and rationale.
Attach the capacity check output to the file.
Date the record so it can be compared with the placement timeline.
Done when the line decision, rationale and capacity evidence are filed.
verify: Open the file and check line, position and capacity evidence are present.
Pass when the filed record shows line amount, position and capacity check.

generic.Defined scope/population: The draft treaty wording circulated to cedant, placing broker and internal legal.
generic.In-scope period: From circulation of the draft to the stated comment deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Draft version, recipient list, comment deadline and clause references populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Comments logged equal the comments received across all three parties.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Circulated draft filed with its version, distribution list and deadline.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties not responding by the deadline logged with the chase date and outcome.
generic.Test population: All comments received on the circulated draft from every recipient party.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the circulated version is not the latest draft in the contract repository.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty Specialist escalates to the underwriter where a party will not comment in time.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Circulated draft version with dated distribution list and stated comment deadline.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository draft record with email distribution evidence.

steps.title: Confirm the circulated version is the latest draft in the contract repository
sop: Open the contract lifecycle repository and take the current draft version.
Check no later version exists in a local working folder.
Record the version number to be circulated.
Done when the latest repository version is identified for circulation.
verify: Compare the version to be circulated with the repository latest version.
Pass when the circulated version equals the repository latest version.

steps.title: Enable tracked changes and set the comment deadline on the draft
sop: Enable tracked changes on the circulated draft.
State the comment deadline in the covering email.
State that comments must reference the clause number.
Done when the draft is prepared with tracked changes and a stated deadline.
verify: Open the prepared draft and check tracked changes are enabled.
Pass when the circulated draft has tracked changes enabled and a deadline stated.

steps.title: Circulate to cedant, broker and internal legal in the same round
sop: Send the draft to the cedant, the placing broker and internal legal together.
Record the send date and each recipient.
Keep the round together so comments can be compared side by side.
Done when all three parties have received the same draft in one round.
verify: Check the distribution list covers all three parties with dates.
Pass when the dated distribution list includes cedant, broker and legal.

steps.title: Log every comment received against the clause it relates to
sop: Record each comment with the commenting party and clause reference.
Note whether the comment changes coverage, price or administration.
Keep comments that arrive by email in the same log as repository comments.
Done when every comment received is logged against a clause.
verify: Count logged comments against comments received.
Pass when every received comment appears in the log with a clause reference.

steps.title: Chase parties that have not responded before the deadline
sop: Identify parties with no response as the deadline approaches.
Chase each by email and record the chase date.
Escalate to the underwriter where the deadline will be missed.
Done when every non-responding party has a logged chase.
verify: Compare the chase log with the non-responding party list.
Pass when every non-responding party has a recorded chase.

steps.title: File the circulated draft and distribution list in the repository
sop: File the circulated version and the dated distribution list together.
File the comment log against the same draft version.
Close the comment round once the deadline passes.
Done when the draft, distribution list and comment log are filed together.
verify: Open the filed record and check the distribution list carries dates.
Pass when the filed record shows the version, dated list and comment log.

generic.Defined scope/population: The treaty wording or slip drafted from the agreed terms for this placement.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period of cover the draft is being written for.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Business covered, territory, period, limit, attachment, reinstatements and premium populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Operative clause values equal the agreed terms recorded in the negotiation log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft stored in the contract repository with template version and draft version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every deviation from the standard template marked and routed for legal review.
generic.Test population: All operative clauses plus the mandated clause set in the drafted wording.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a mandated clause is absent from the draft wording.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty Specialist routes template deviations to legal before the draft is circulated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft built from the approved template with the mandated clause set inserted.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository draft record with the Excel terms comparison.

steps.title: Start from the approved market or house template in the contract repository
sop: Open the approved template for the class rather than copying a prior deal.
Record the template name and version on the draft record.
Confirm the template is the current approved version.
Done when the draft is started from the current approved template.
verify: Compare the template version used with the current approved version.
Pass when the draft uses the current approved template version.

steps.title: Populate the operative clauses from the agreed terms
sop: Populate business covered, territorial scope, period, limit and attachment.
Populate reinstatements, premium and commission terms.
Take every value from the agreed terms record rather than memory.
Done when all operative clauses are populated from the agreed terms.
verify: Compare each operative clause value with the negotiation log final terms.
Pass when every operative clause matches the agreed final terms.

steps.title: Insert the mandated clause set into the draft
sop: Insert sanctions, exclusions, arbitration and jurisdiction clauses.
Insert currency, loss notification and offset clauses.
Check each inserted clause is the current mandated version.
Done when the full mandated clause set is present in the draft.
verify: Check the draft against the mandated clause checklist.
Pass when every mandated clause appears in the draft.

steps.title: Confirm the draft supports treatment as reinsurance rather than deposit accounting
sop: Review the risk-transfer characteristics of the drafted structure.
Check that limits, commissions and loss corridors do not remove underwriting risk.
Raise the wording to legal where risk transfer is not clear.
Done when risk transfer is confirmed or raised for legal review.
verify: Read the risk-transfer conclusion recorded on the draft.
Pass when a risk-transfer conclusion is recorded for the draft.

steps.title: Mark every deviation from the standard template
sop: Compare the draft with the template and mark each deviation.
Record the reason for each deviation in the Excel comparison.
Route the deviation list for legal review.
Done when every deviation is marked with a reason and routed.
verify: Count marked deviations against the template comparison output.
Pass when every deviation identified in the comparison is marked and routed.

steps.title: Save the draft version in the contract lifecycle repository
sop: Save the draft against the treaty reference with its version number.
Attach the terms comparison and deviation list.
Confirm no working copy is left outside the repository.
Done when the draft version and its attachments are saved in the repository.
verify: Search working folders for copies of the draft.
Pass when the repository holds the only working copy of the draft.

generic.Defined scope/population: The final agreed contract text being executed by the cedant and the company.
generic.In-scope period: From release of the execution version to full execution and version lock.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty reference, period, signed line, signatory names and both signature dates populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Execution version content equals the final agreed text with all amendments incorporated.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed document stored with both signature dates and the version locked.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Signatory authority queries logged and resolved before signature is obtained.
generic.Test population: The execution version and both signature records for the contract.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an executed contract remains in editable draft status.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager confirms signatory authority where the class or limit is unusual.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Fully executed contract with both signature dates captured and the version locked.
generic.Evidence location: DocuSign envelope with the executed contract stored in the contract repository.

steps.title: Confirm the execution version incorporates all agreed amendments
sop: Compare the execution version with the final agreed text and amendment log.
Confirm every agreed amendment is incorporated.
Produce a clean copy for signature.
Done when the execution version carries every agreed amendment.
verify: Run a comparison between the execution version and the last agreed text.
Pass when the comparison shows no unagreed difference.

steps.title: Confirm the signatory holds authority to bind for this class and limit
sop: Check the proposed signatory against the signing authority schedule.
Confirm the authority covers this class and this limit.
Reroute to an authorised signatory where it does not.
Done when an authorised signatory is confirmed for the contract.
verify: Compare the signatory authority with the contract class and limit.
Pass when the signatory holds authority for the class and limit signed.

steps.title: Send the execution version for signature through DocuSign
sop: Create the DocuSign envelope with the cedant and company signatories.
Set the signing order and the completion deadline.
Send the envelope and record the send date.
Done when the envelope is sent to both signatories.
verify: Check the envelope recipients against the intended signatories.
Pass when the envelope lists the correct cedant and company signatories.

steps.title: Capture cedant signature and company countersignature dates
sop: Track the envelope until both signatures are applied.
Capture both signature dates from the completion certificate.
Chase any signatory outstanding past the deadline.
Done when both signatures are applied and both dates are captured.
verify: Read the completion certificate for both signature dates.
Pass when both signature dates are present on the completion certificate.

steps.title: Check the executed document carries the correct reference, period and signed line
sop: Check the treaty reference, period and signed line on the executed document.
Compare them with the administration system treaty record.
Raise a correction where any element disagrees.
Done when reference, period and signed line are confirmed correct.
verify: Compare the executed document with the treaty record.
Pass when reference, period and signed line agree with the system record.

steps.title: Mark the contract executed and lock the version in the repository
sop: Store the executed document in the contract repository.
Mark the record executed and lock the version against further editing.
Confirm no editable copy of the executed text remains.
Done when the contract is marked executed and the version is locked.
verify: Attempt to edit the executed version in the repository.
Pass when the executed version cannot be edited.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every amendment requested by any party on the circulated treaty wording.
generic.In-scope period: From first amendment request to agreement of the final text by all parties.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requesting party, clause reference, commercial impact and agreed outcome populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Amendment log entries equal the changes present in the final marked-up comparison.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Clean and marked-up versions stored against the last circulated version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage-scope amendments logged with the underwriter agreement or rejection.
generic.Test population: All amendment requests recorded against the wording for this treaty.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a coverage-scope amendment is accepted without underwriter agreement.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty Specialist refers scope, limit and exclusion changes to the underwriter before accepting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clause-level amendment log with requesting party and the agreed outcome recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository amendment log with email agreement evidence.

steps.title: Log each amendment request with party, clause and commercial impact
sop: Record the requesting party and the clause reference for each request.
State the commercial impact of the change in the log.
Keep one row per amendment so outcomes stay traceable.
Done when every amendment request is logged with party, clause and impact.
verify: Count logged amendments against requests received.
Pass when every request received appears once in the amendment log.

steps.title: Refer coverage, limit and exclusion changes to the underwriter
sop: Identify amendments that change coverage scope, limit or exclusions.
Refer each to the underwriter for agreement before it is accepted.
Record the underwriter decision against the amendment row.
Done when every coverage-affecting amendment has an underwriter decision.
verify: Match underwriter decisions against coverage-affecting amendments.
Pass when no coverage-affecting amendment is accepted without a decision.

steps.title: Confirm sanctions and mandated exclusion clauses remain intact
sop: Check the final text still contains the mandated sanctions and exclusion clauses.
Reject any amendment that weakens a mandated clause.
Escalate where a party insists on weakening a mandated clause.
Done when the mandated clauses are confirmed intact in the final text.
verify: Check the final text against the mandated clause checklist.
Pass when every mandated clause remains present and unweakened.

steps.title: Produce clean and marked-up comparisons against the last circulated version
sop: Produce the clean final text in the contract repository.
Produce the marked-up comparison against the last circulated version.
Check the marked-up changes match the amendment log.
Done when clean and marked-up versions exist and agree with the log.
verify: Compare the marked-up changes with the amendment log entries.
Pass when every marked-up change appears in the amendment log.

steps.title: Circulate the final text for agreement by all parties over email
sop: Send the clean and marked-up versions to cedant, broker and legal.
Ask each party to confirm agreement to the final text.
Chase any party that has not confirmed.
Done when the final text has been circulated to all parties for agreement.
verify: Check the circulation list covers every party to the contract.
Pass when every party to the contract received the final text.

steps.title: Record agreement of all parties to the final text with dates
sop: Record each party agreement with the date it was given.
File the agreement evidence against the final version.
Release the text to execution only once all parties have agreed.
Done when every party agreement is recorded with a date.
verify: Read the agreement record for missing parties or dates.
Pass when every party has a dated agreement recorded before execution.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every non-standard clause in the treaty wording that deviates from the approved template.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the deviations until execution of the contract.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Clause reference, deviation reason, reviewer and approval outcome populated per clause.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approvals recorded equal the number of deviations on the deviation list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Per-clause approvals stored against the wording version they relate to.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deviations refused by legal or compliance logged with the resulting wording change.
generic.Test population: All listed non-standard clauses routed to legal and to compliance.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any non-standard clause is executed without a recorded sign-off.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager holds execution until every listed deviation has an approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Per-clause legal and compliance approvals recorded for every deviation identified.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management approval records linked to the contract repository wording version.

steps.title: List each non-standard clause with the reason it deviates from the template
sop: Compare the wording with the approved template and list every deviation.
State the clause reference and the reason for each deviation.
Note the commercial driver where the deviation was requested by a counterparty.
Done when every deviation is listed with clause reference and reason.
verify: Compare the deviation list with the template comparison output.
Pass when every deviation in the comparison appears on the list.

steps.title: Route the deviation list to legal for enforceability review
sop: Raise a legal review task in the workflow tool with the deviation list attached.
Ask for an enforceability view on each listed clause.
Record the routing date so turnaround can be tracked.
Done when the legal review task is raised with the full deviation list.
verify: Check the routed list matches the deviation list on the wording.
Pass when the routed list contains every identified deviation.

steps.title: Route the deviation list to compliance for regulatory and sanctions review
sop: Raise a compliance review task with the same deviation list.
Ask specifically for a sanctions and regulatory view on each clause.
Record the routing date for the compliance task.
Done when the compliance review task is raised with the full deviation list.
verify: Check both legal and compliance tasks exist for the same list.
Pass when both reviews are raised against the same deviation list.

steps.title: Capture written sign-off per clause rather than a blanket approval
sop: Record the legal and compliance outcome against each individual clause.
Reject any blanket approval of the whole document.
Record the reviewer name and date for each clause outcome.
Done when every clause carries its own recorded sign-off.
verify: Count clause-level sign-offs against the deviation list.
Pass when every deviation has its own clause-level sign-off.

steps.title: Confirm risk-transfer and jurisdiction wording carries specific sign-off
sop: Check the risk-transfer wording has a specific recorded approval.
Check the arbitration and jurisdiction wording has a specific approval.
Escalate where either is covered only implicitly.
Done when both wordings carry explicit recorded approvals.
verify: Search the approval records for risk-transfer and jurisdiction entries.
Pass when both carry a named approval record.

steps.title: Hold execution until every listed deviation has a recorded approval
sop: Keep the contract in pre-execution status while approvals are outstanding.
Chase outstanding reviews before the execution deadline.
Release for execution only when the deviation list is fully approved.
Done when execution is released only after every deviation is approved.
verify: Compare the execution release date with the last approval date.
Pass when execution was released after the final deviation approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Mid-term endorsement requests on in-force treaties including reinstatements and extensions.
generic.In-scope period: The endorsement effective date within the in-force treaty period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Endorsement number, effective date, changed terms and premium adjustment populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Additional or return premium calculated agrees with the changed terms recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Endorsement recorded against the treaty with its number and effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exposure-increasing endorsements logged with the authority check and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All mid-term endorsements processed against in-force assumed treaties.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an exposure-increasing endorsement is processed without an authority check.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter agrees and refers endorsements that increase exposure or extend period.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Endorsement recorded with number, effective date, changed terms and premium adjustment.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system endorsement record in Sapiens ReinsurancePro.

steps.title: Confirm the endorsement request falls within the treaty terms
sop: Retrieve the in-force wording from the contract repository.
Check whether the request is already provided for, such as a reinstatement.
Flag requests that require a new agreement rather than an endorsement.
Done when the request is confirmed as within terms or flagged as a new agreement.
verify: Compare the request with the relevant clause in the in-force wording.
Pass when the request is supported by the wording or flagged for agreement.

steps.title: Obtain underwriter agreement to the endorsement
sop: Review the endorsement for exposure, period and pricing effect.
Agree or reject the endorsement and record the decision.
State any condition attached to the agreement.
Done when the underwriter decision on the endorsement is recorded.
verify: Check the decision record names the underwriter and the date.
Pass when the endorsement carries a dated underwriter decision.

steps.title: Run a fresh authority check where exposure increases or period extends
sop: Identify whether the endorsement increases exposure or extends the period.
Run the authority check against the current matrix for the revised position.
Refer where the revised position exceeds authority.
Done when an authority check exists for every exposure-increasing endorsement.
verify: Match authority checks against exposure-increasing endorsements.
Pass when no exposure-increasing endorsement lacks an authority check.

steps.title: Calculate the additional or return premium arising
sop: Calculate the additional or return premium from the changed terms.
Apply the agreed basis such as pro-rata as to time or amount.
Record the calculation basis alongside the amount.
Done when the premium adjustment is calculated with its basis recorded.
verify: Recompute the adjustment from the changed terms and basis.
Pass when the recomputed adjustment matches the recorded amount.

steps.title: Record the endorsement against the treaty in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Create the endorsement with its number and effective date.
Enter the changed terms and the premium adjustment.
Link the endorsement to the in-force treaty record.
Done when the endorsement is recorded and linked to the treaty.
verify: Open the treaty record and check the endorsement appears in sequence.
Pass when the endorsement is visible on the treaty with number and effective date.

steps.title: Notify technical accounting and the broker of the endorsed terms
sop: Send the endorsed terms and premium adjustment to technical accounting.
Send the endorsement confirmation to the broker.
Record both notifications against the endorsement.
Done when both notifications are sent and recorded.
verify: Check the endorsement record for both notification entries.
Pass when both technical accounting and broker notifications are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The executed treaty wording being published to the assumed treaty register.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period the published wording covers.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty reference, cedant, period, class and lead or follow status populated on the entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register key fields equal the corresponding terms in the executed wording.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Register entry stores the executed version with its publication date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Register field mismatches logged and corrected before the entry goes live.
generic.Test population: All register entries published for executed assumed treaties in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where draft wording is published as the active register version.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Ops Manager withholds publication where the executed version is not available.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Executed wording published with treaty reference, period and key terms tagged.
generic.Evidence location: Treaty repository register entry linked to the executed document in the repository.

steps.title: Retrieve the executed final version from the document repository
sop: Retrieve the executed wording marked final in the repository.
Confirm the version is executed and not a draft or working copy.
Record the version and execution date to be published.
Done when the executed final version is retrieved for publication.
verify: Check the retrieved version status is executed.
Pass when the version selected for publication is marked executed.

steps.title: Create the register entry in the treaty repository with identifying tags
sop: Create the entry with treaty reference, cedant, period and class.
Tag the entry with lead or follow status.
Attach the executed wording to the entry.
Done when the register entry is created with all identifying tags.
verify: Check every identifying tag is populated on the entry.
Pass when no identifying tag is left blank on the register entry.

steps.title: Check register key fields against the executed wording
sop: Compare limit, attachment, reinstatements and commission in the register with the wording.
Correct any field that does not match the executed text.
Record the check date and the checker.
Done when every key register field matches the executed wording.
verify: Re-read the key fields against the wording after correction.
Pass when no key register field differs from the executed wording.

steps.title: Confirm claims and technical accounting can retrieve the wording
sop: Check the register permissions allow claims and accounting read access.
Test retrieval of the wording from a claims and an accounting profile.
Correct permissions where retrieval fails.
Done when both teams can retrieve the published wording.
verify: Retrieve the wording using a downstream user profile.
Pass when the wording opens successfully from a downstream profile.

steps.title: Retire the prior period wording entry as superseded
sop: Locate the prior period entry for the same treaty.
Mark it superseded and record its retirement date.
Keep it retrievable for historical claims enquiries.
Done when the prior period entry is marked superseded with a date.
verify: Search the register for active entries for the same treaty.
Pass when only one entry per treaty period is marked active.

steps.title: Publish the entry and record the publication date
sop: Publish the register entry as the active version.
Record the publication date and the publishing user.
Confirm no draft wording is published as active.
Done when the entry is live with its publication date recorded.
verify: List active register entries and check their document status.
Pass when no active register entry points to a draft wording.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every clause in the treaty wording compared against the corresponding term on the signed slip.
generic.In-scope period: The period between wording agreement and contract execution.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Clause reference, slip term, wording term and matched or exception status populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Clauses reconciled equal the number of terms recorded on the signed slip.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation stored with reviewer name and completion date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every mismatch raised as a contract-certainty exception with its resolution.
generic.Test population: All slip terms including limit, attachment, reinstatements, premium, commission and period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any slip-to-wording exception remains unresolved at execution.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter resolves mismatches before the contract is released for execution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clause-level reconciliation completed with reviewer name and completion date.
generic.Evidence location: Contract repository reconciliation record with the Excel comparison workbook attached.

steps.title: Build the slip-to-wording comparison in the Excel reconciliation workbook
sop: List every term on the signed slip as a row in the workbook.
Enter the corresponding wording clause reference for each term.
Leave no slip term without a wording reference.
Done when every slip term has a matching wording clause reference.
verify: Count slip terms against workbook rows.
Pass when the workbook covers every term on the signed slip.

steps.title: Reconcile limit, attachment, reinstatements, premium and commission
sop: Compare each financial term in the wording with the slip value.
Mark each term matched or exception.
Record the exact difference for each exception.
Done when every financial term is marked matched or exception.
verify: Re-read two financial terms directly from the wording.
Pass when the re-read values agree with the reconciliation entries.

steps.title: Reconcile exclusions and territorial scope to what was quoted and bound
sop: Compare the exclusion list in the wording with the quoted and bound exclusions.
Compare territorial scope in the wording with the bound scope.
Record any addition or omission as an exception.
Done when exclusions and territorial scope are reconciled to the bound terms.
verify: Check the exclusion comparison covers every mandated exclusion.
Pass when every mandated exclusion appears in the comparison.

steps.title: Raise each mismatch as a contract-certainty exception
sop: Raise an exception in the contract repository for each mismatch.
State the slip value, the wording value and the correction required.
Assign an owner and a resolution date to each exception.
Done when every mismatch is raised as an exception with an owner.
verify: Match the exception list against the mismatches in the workbook.
Pass when every workbook exception has a corresponding raised exception.

steps.title: Resolve all exceptions before the contract is released for execution
sop: Agree the correct term for each exception with the broker or cedant.
Amend the wording and re-check the affected clause.
Close the exception once the wording matches the agreed term.
Done when every exception is closed and the wording is corrected.
verify: List open exceptions at the point of execution release.
Pass when no slip-to-wording exception is open at execution.

steps.title: Record the reviewer name and completion date on the reconciliation
sop: Record the reviewer name and the completion date on the reconciliation.
File the reconciliation against the wording version reviewed.
Attach the Excel comparison workbook to the same record.
Done when the reconciliation is filed with reviewer name and date.
verify: Open the filed reconciliation and check the reviewer and date fields.
Pass when the filed reconciliation carries a reviewer name and completion date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The executed contract with all schedules and endorsements for the treaty being filed.
generic.In-scope period: From contract execution to filing in the document management system.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty reference, cedant, class and period metadata populated on the filed document.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pages and schedules filed equal those in the executed contract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filing date and filer recorded against the treaty record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Illegible or incomplete uploads logged and re-filed before the record is closed.
generic.Test population: The stored contract file and its metadata for every executed treaty.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an executed treaty is stored without cedant, class and period metadata.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty Specialist re-uploads and re-checks any file that fails the legibility check.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed contract with all schedules stored under the treaty reference with metadata.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository treaty folder cross-linked to the contract repository.

steps.title: Assemble the executed contract with all schedules and endorsements
sop: Collect the executed wording, schedules and any endorsements issued.
Check the set is complete against the contract repository record.
Order the documents so the contract reads in sequence.
Done when the complete executed set is assembled for filing.
verify: Compare the assembled set with the contract repository contents.
Pass when the assembled set matches the repository record.

steps.title: File the set under the treaty reference in the document repository
sop: Create the filing under the treaty reference in the repository.
Upload the executed contract and all schedules.
Confirm the filing sits in the correct treaty folder.
Done when the executed set is filed under the treaty reference.
verify: Search the repository on the treaty reference.
Pass when the search returns the filed executed contract.

steps.title: Populate cedant, class and period metadata on the filing
sop: Populate the cedant, class and period metadata fields.
Use the same values as the administration system treaty record.
Correct any metadata field left at a default value.
Done when cedant, class and period metadata are populated.
verify: Compare the metadata with the administration system record.
Pass when the metadata matches the treaty record values.

steps.title: Set retention and access permissions for claims and accounting
sop: Apply the reinsurance contract retention period to the filing.
Set read access for claims and technical accounting.
Prevent amendment rights for downstream readers.
Done when retention and read-only downstream access are set.
verify: Test the filing from a downstream read-only profile.
Pass when a downstream user can read but not amend the filing.
