steps.title: Verify the uploaded document opens and is legible
sop: Open the uploaded document end to end.
Check every page and schedule is legible and complete.
Re-upload where any page fails the check.
Done when the uploaded document opens and is legible throughout.
verify: Spot-check the signature pages and the schedules.
Pass when the signature pages and schedules are legible.

steps.title: Record the filing date and filer against the treaty record
sop: Record the filing date and the filer on the treaty record.
Cross-link the filing to the contract repository entry.
Close the filing task once the link resolves.
Done when the filing date, filer and cross-link are recorded.
verify: Open the cross-link from the treaty record.
Pass when the cross-link resolves to the filed executed contract.

generic.Defined scope/population: The signed contract wording being stored as the definitive version in the record repository.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period covered by the signed wording being stored.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, execution date, treaty reference and retention period populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Version and execution date on the stored copy match the execution record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Stored wording cross-linked to the register entry and administration system record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Editable duplicates found in working folders logged and removed.
generic.Test population: The stored signed wording and every location holding a copy of it.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an editable duplicate of the signed wording remains in a working folder.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Ops Manager directs removal of any uncontrolled copy discovered.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed wording stored and cross-linked to register and administration system records.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository record store with the treaty repository cross-link.

steps.title: Store the signed wording as the definitive version in the record repository
sop: Upload the signed wording to the record repository under the treaty reference.
Mark the record as the definitive contract version.
Lock the record against editing.
Done when the signed wording is stored and marked definitive.
verify: Check the record status and edit permissions.
Pass when the stored record is marked definitive and cannot be edited.

steps.title: Cross-link the stored wording to the treaty register entry
sop: Add a link from the register entry to the stored wording.
Add the reverse link from the stored wording to the register entry.
Test both links resolve.
Done when both links between store and register resolve.
verify: Follow the link in each direction.
Pass when both links resolve to the intended records.

steps.title: Cross-link the stored wording to the administration system record
sop: Add the stored wording reference to the administration system treaty record.
Confirm the reference resolves from the treaty record.
Correct the reference where it points to a superseded version.
Done when the administration system record links to the stored wording.
verify: Open the wording from the administration system treaty record.
Pass when the link opens the definitive stored wording.

steps.title: Confirm version number and execution date match the execution record
sop: Compare the stored copy version number with the execution record.
Compare the execution date on the stored copy with the completion certificate.
Replace the stored copy where either disagrees.
Done when version and execution date match the execution record.
verify: Read version and execution date from both records.
Pass when the stored copy and execution record agree on both.

steps.title: Apply the retention period required for reinsurance contracts
sop: Apply the reinsurance contract retention class to the stored record.
Confirm the retention runs from the correct date basis.
Record the retention class applied.
Done when the correct retention class is applied and recorded.
verify: Check the retention class and start date on the record.
Pass when the applied retention matches the reinsurance contract policy.

steps.title: Remove editable copies of the signed wording from working folders
sop: Search working folders for copies of the signed wording.
Remove or lock every editable copy found.
Record what was removed and when.
Done when no editable duplicate of the signed wording remains.
verify: Re-run the working folder search after removal.
Pass when the search returns no editable copy of the signed wording.

generic.Defined scope/population: The clauses, exclusions and territorial scope in the treaty wording awaiting verification.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty period of cover stated in the wording being verified.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Business covered, exclusions, territory, jurisdiction, limit and reinstatements populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Monetary provisions in the wording agree with the bound terms on the treaty record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Verification recorded against the wording version with the verifier name and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ambiguous or inconsistent clauses logged and corrected before sign-off.
generic.Test population: All operative clauses, the exclusion list and the territorial and jurisdiction clauses.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where risk transfer is not confirmed before the terms are signed off as correct.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter refers unresolved wording ambiguity to legal before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Underwriter verification covering clauses, exclusions, territorial scope and risk transfer.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle repository verification record with the treaty repository wording version.

steps.title: Verify the business-covered clause matches the portfolio quoted
sop: Read the business-covered clause against the portfolio described in the submission.
Check the classes covered match the classes rated and quoted.
Record any class covered that was not rated.
Done when the business-covered clause is verified against the quoted portfolio.
verify: Compare the covered class list with the rated class list.
Pass when the covered classes match the classes rated and quoted.

steps.title: Verify the exclusions list is complete including deal-specific carve-outs
sop: Check sanctions, communicable disease and cyber exclusions are present.
Check every deal-specific carve-out agreed in negotiation is included.
Record any exclusion missing or weakened.
Done when the exclusion list is verified complete against the agreed set.
verify: Check the exclusion list against the mandated and agreed exclusion set.
Pass when no mandated or agreed exclusion is missing.

steps.title: Verify territorial scope and jurisdiction clauses are consistent
sop: Read the territorial scope clause and the jurisdiction clause together.
Check they do not create cover in a territory the jurisdiction cannot support.
Raise a correction where the two clauses conflict.
Done when territorial scope and jurisdiction are verified consistent.
verify: Re-read both clauses after any correction.
Pass when the territorial and jurisdiction clauses read consistently.

steps.title: Verify limit, attachment, reinstatement and aggregate provisions read unambiguously
sop: Check each monetary provision is stated in figures and currency.
Check aggregate and occurrence provisions cannot be read two ways.
Correct any provision open to interpretation.
Done when all monetary provisions read unambiguously.
verify: Compare the monetary provisions with the bound terms on the treaty record.
Pass when the wording provisions agree with the bound treaty terms.

steps.title: Confirm the contract retains genuine risk transfer
sop: Review commissions, corridors and caps for their effect on risk transfer.
Confirm meaningful underwriting risk remains with the reinsurer.
Refer to legal where risk transfer is doubtful.
Done when the risk-transfer conclusion is recorded on the verification.
verify: Read the recorded risk-transfer conclusion.
Pass when a risk-transfer confirmation is recorded on the verification.

steps.title: Record the verification against the wording version
sop: Record the verification outcome against the wording version reviewed.
Record the verifier name and the verification date.
List any correction required before execution.
Done when the verification is recorded with name, date and corrections.
verify: Open the verification record and check name, date and version.
Pass when the verification names the wording version, verifier and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every inbound facultative submission requiring acknowledgement to the placing broker.
generic.In-scope period: From submission receipt until acknowledgement within the agreed service standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission reference, expected response date and handling contact populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledgements sent equal the submissions registered in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgement timestamp recorded against the submission record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Acknowledgements sent outside the service standard logged with the cause.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions registered in the period and their acknowledgements.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where acknowledgement is sent later than the agreed service standard from receipt.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst escalates to the facultative underwriter where no handler can be named.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledgement quoting the submission reference and the expected response date.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation submission record with the email acknowledgement attached.

steps.title: Open the registered submission in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the submission record created at registration.
Confirm the submission reference and receipt timestamp are present.
Confirm the broker contact of record is populated.
Done when the submission record is open with reference, receipt and contact.
verify: Check the receipt timestamp is recorded on the submission.
Pass when the submission carries a receipt timestamp and a broker contact.

steps.title: Determine the expected indication or quote date
sop: Apply the service standard to the receipt date to derive the response date.
Adjust for the broker deadline where it is earlier.
Record the expected date on the submission.
Done when the expected indication or quote date is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded date with the service standard and broker deadline.
Pass when the recorded date is the earlier of standard and broker deadline.

steps.title: Name the handling underwriter or triage contact
sop: Identify the handling underwriter or the triage contact for follow-up.
Confirm the named person is available for the response period.
Record the name on the submission record.
Done when a handling contact is named on the submission.
verify: Check the named contact against the assignment record.
Pass when the named contact matches the assigned handler.

steps.title: Send the acknowledgement to the broker by email
sop: Send the acknowledgement quoting the submission reference.
State the expected indication or quote date and the handling contact.
Send within the agreed service standard of receipt.
Done when the acknowledgement is sent to the broker.
verify: Compare the send timestamp with the receipt timestamp.
Pass when the elapsed time is within the agreed service standard.

steps.title: Record the acknowledgement timestamp against the submission
sop: Record the acknowledgement send timestamp on the submission record.
Attach the sent acknowledgement to the submission.
Set the submission status to acknowledged.
Done when the timestamp and acknowledgement copy are recorded.
verify: Open the submission and check the acknowledgement attachment and timestamp.
Pass when both the timestamp and the sent copy are held on the submission.

steps.title: Log any acknowledgement outside the service standard with its cause
sop: Identify acknowledgements sent later than the service standard.
Record the cause of the delay against the submission.
Report repeated causes to the facultative underwriter.
Done when every late acknowledgement carries a recorded cause.
verify: List late acknowledgements for the period against recorded causes.
Pass when every late acknowledgement has a recorded cause.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound facultative submissions awaiting assignment to a handling underwriter.
generic.In-scope period: From triage classification to assignment within the working day of receipt.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Risk type, class, territory, assigned underwriter, priority and timestamp populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned submissions equal the submissions registered and cleared for assignment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment and priority recorded on the submission record with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reassignments due to absence or authority logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All submissions assigned in the period and the authority held by each assignee.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a submission is assigned to an underwriter without authority for its class.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager reassigns where the first-choice underwriter lacks authority or availability.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission assigned to a named underwriter with class, priority and timestamp recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation submission record with the workflow assignment entry.

steps.title: Classify the submission by risk type, class and territory
sop: Read the submission and classify the risk type, class and territory.
Record the classification on the submission record.
Query the broker where the risk type cannot be determined.
Done when the submission carries a risk type, class and territory.
verify: Check the classification fields are populated on the submission.
Pass when risk type, class and territory are all recorded.

steps.title: Identify underwriters holding authority for the class and expected line size
sop: Check the authority matrix for underwriters covering this class and territory.
Filter to those whose authority covers the expected line size.
Note where no underwriter holds the required authority.
Done when the eligible underwriter list is identified.
verify: Compare the eligible list with the authority matrix.
Pass when every listed underwriter holds authority for the class and size.

steps.title: Set the priority from the broker deadline and opportunity size
sop: Read the broker deadline and the estimated premium for the risk.
Set the priority level from the agreed priority rules.
Record the priority on the submission.
Done when the submission carries a priority level.
verify: Compare the priority set with the broker deadline and premium size.
Pass when the priority is consistent with the agreed priority rules.

steps.title: Confirm the assigned underwriter is available
sop: Check the intended assignee is not out of office during the response window.
Reassign to another authorised underwriter where they are unavailable.
Record the reason for any reassignment.
Done when the assignee is confirmed available for the response window.
verify: Check the assignee availability against the expected response date.
Pass when the assignee is available before the expected response date.

steps.title: Assign the submission in the workflow case management tool
sop: Assign the submission to the named underwriter in the workflow tool.
Carry the class, territory and priority onto the assignment.
Record the assignment timestamp.
Done when the submission is assigned with priority and timestamp.
verify: Open the assignment and check the named assignee and timestamp.
Pass when the assignment names an underwriter and carries a timestamp.

steps.title: Reflect the assignment on the workstation submission record
sop: Update the workstation submission record with the assignee and priority.
Confirm the record appears on the assignee pipeline view.
Notify the assignee that the submission is with them.
Done when the assignment is visible on the assignee pipeline view.
verify: Open the assignee pipeline view and locate the submission.
Pass when the submission appears on the assigned underwriter pipeline.

generic.Defined scope/population: The inbound facultative risk checked against the existing assumed book for duplication.
generic.In-scope period: The inception period of the risk offered plus in-force and quoted positions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured name, location, inception date and clearance outcome populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Clearance searches performed equal the submissions progressed for appraisal.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Clearance outcome recorded against the submission reference with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicates and blocked risks logged with the decision on which approach is held.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions progressed past triage in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where duplicate participation is bound on the same risk via two broker approaches.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative underwriter decides which broker approach is retained where a duplicate is found.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clearance search performed with the outcome recorded against the submission.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation clearance record with the administration system search evidence.

steps.title: Search the assumed book on insured name, location and inception
sop: Search the administration system on insured name, location and inception date.
Use name variants and the parent company name to catch near matches.
Record the search terms used.
Done when the search is run on all three attributes with variants.
verify: Check the search terms recorded include name variants.
Pass when the recorded search covers name, location and inception.

steps.title: Check whether the same risk is offered through another broker
sop: Search open submissions for the same risk from a different broker.
Compare insured, location and period to confirm it is the same risk.
Record any parallel approach found.
Done when parallel broker approaches are identified or ruled out.
verify: Check the search covered open submissions as well as bound business.
Pass when both open and bound records were searched.

steps.title: Check whether the risk is already covered by an inwards treaty
sop: Check whether the cedant treaty already covers the risk being offered.
Identify any inuring treaty that would apply to the facultative line.
Record the treaty reference where one applies.
Done when treaty coverage of the risk is identified or ruled out.
verify: Check any identified treaty reference resolves to an in-force treaty.
Pass when every cited treaty reference is in force for the period.

steps.title: Decide which broker approach is held where a duplicate is found
sop: Establish which broker held the original approach and when.
Decide which approach is retained and which is declined.
Record the decision and the reason.
Done when the retained approach is decided and recorded.
verify: Check the decision names the retained and declined approaches.
Pass when only one approach on the risk is left open.

steps.title: Check for a related risk already declined
sop: Search declined submissions for the same insured or location.
Read the decline reason on any related record.
Flag the submission where a decline stance already exists.
Done when related declines are identified and flagged.
verify: Check the decline search covered the same insured and location.
Pass when the decline search covered both insured and location.

steps.title: Record the clearance outcome against the submission reference
sop: Record the outcome as clear, duplicate or blocked.
Attach the search evidence to the submission record.
Set the submission status so blocked risks cannot progress.
Done when the clearance outcome and evidence are recorded.
verify: List submissions progressed for appraisal against clearance outcomes.
Pass when no submission progressed without a recorded clearance outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: The cedant, its parent and the placing broker on the facultative submission being cleared.
generic.In-scope period: The current submission, using the panel assessment valid at the screening date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Panel status, assessment expiry, screening result and remaining credit limit populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parties screened equal cedant plus parent plus broker for each submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening reference and eligibility outcome recorded against the submission.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Screening hits logged with the clearance decision and the person who cleared them.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions cleared for quoting in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a submission progresses for a cedant with an expired or absent panel assessment.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Credit and Security Analyst holds the submission until a hit is cleared.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Screening run and cleared for cedant, parent and broker before any quote is issued.
generic.Evidence location: Sanctions screening system case record linked to the administration system submission.

steps.title: Confirm the cedant appears on the approved panel with a current assessment
sop: Look up the cedant on the approved counterparty panel.
Check the assessment is present and has not expired.
Hold the submission where the assessment is absent or stale.
Done when panel status and assessment validity are confirmed.
verify: Compare the assessment expiry date with the screening date.
Pass when the assessment is unexpired at the screening date.

steps.title: Check the cedant is not on the no-write list or credit blocked
sop: Check the cedant against the no-write list.
Check for an open credit block or unresolved dispute.
Record the outcome of both checks.
Done when no-write and credit block checks are recorded.
verify: Re-run both checks after any record update.
Pass when the cedant is clear of the no-write list and credit blocks.

steps.title: Run sanctions screening on cedant, parent and broker
sop: Screen the cedant, its parent and the placing broker in the screening system.
Record the screening reference for each party.
Clear or escalate any hit before the submission progresses.
Done when all three parties are screened with references recorded.
verify: Count screening references against the three required parties.
Pass when a screening reference exists for cedant, parent and broker.

steps.title: Clear or escalate every screening hit before quoting
sop: Review each hit and determine whether it is a true or false match.
Record the clearance decision and the person clearing it.
Escalate true matches and stop the submission.
Done when every hit is cleared or escalated with a recorded decision.
verify: List open hits against the submission before quoting.
Pass when no screening hit remains open at the quote point.

steps.title: Check remaining cedant credit and exposure limit supports the line
sop: Retrieve the cedant aggregate credit limit and committed exposure.
Compare remaining limit with the line contemplated.
Refer where the limit would be exceeded.
Done when remaining credit limit is compared with the contemplated line.
verify: Recompute remaining limit from the aggregate limit and committed exposure.
Pass when the recomputed remaining limit supports the contemplated line.

steps.title: Record the eligibility outcome and screening reference on the submission
sop: Record eligible or not eligible against the submission.
Record the screening references and the check date.
Set the submission status so ineligible risks cannot progress.
Done when the eligibility outcome and references are recorded.
verify: List submissions quoted in the period against eligibility outcomes.
Pass when no submission was quoted without a recorded eligibility outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every live facultative submission being worked, from receipt to quote or decline.
generic.In-scope period: From pipeline entry creation until the submission reaches a closed status.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cedant, broker, class, territory, inception, estimated premium and target dates populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pipeline entries equal the registered submissions currently being worked.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pipeline entry links to the submission documents with a current status and dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions worked outside the pipeline logged and entered retrospectively.
generic.Test population: All live submissions in the facultative team pipeline for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a live submission is being worked without a pipeline record.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative underwriter confirms target dates where the broker deadline is unachievable.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pipeline entry with target indication and quote dates and a live status.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation pipeline entry linked to the workflow case record.

steps.title: Create the pipeline entry in the underwriting workstation
sop: Create the entry with cedant, broker, class, territory and inception.
Enter the estimated premium for the opportunity.
Quote the submission reference on the entry.
Done when the pipeline entry exists with all identifying fields.
verify: Check every identifying field is populated on the entry.
Pass when no identifying field on the pipeline entry is blank.

steps.title: Set target indication and firm-quote dates
sop: Derive the target indication date from the service standard.
Set the firm-quote date from the broker deadline where earlier.
Flag where the broker deadline cannot be met.
Done when both target dates are set on the pipeline entry.
verify: Compare the set dates with the service standard and broker deadline.
Pass when both dates are set and consistent with the earlier of the two.

steps.title: Set the pipeline status to a live value
sop: Set the status to received, under review, quoted or declined.
Avoid leaving the entry at a default or blank status.
Update the status whenever the submission moves stage.
Done when the entry carries a current live status.
verify: List pipeline entries with blank or stale statuses.
Pass when no live entry is left without a current status.

steps.title: Link the pipeline entry to the submission documents
sop: Link the entry to the submission documents held against the reference.
Confirm nothing about the submission is tracked outside the system.
Attach any broker correspondence to the same record.
Done when the entry links to the full submission document set.
verify: Open the documents from the pipeline entry.
Pass when the submission documents open from the pipeline entry.

steps.title: Mirror the entry as a case in the workflow case management tool
sop: Create or confirm the matching workflow case for the submission.
Carry the target dates and priority onto the case.
Confirm case and pipeline statuses stay aligned.
Done when the workflow case exists and matches the pipeline entry.
verify: Compare the case status with the pipeline status.
Pass when the case and pipeline statuses agree.

steps.title: Confirm the entry appears on underwriter and manager pipeline views
sop: Open the underwriter pipeline view and locate the entry.
Open the manager pipeline view and locate the entry.
Correct the assignment or status where it is missing from either view.
Done when the entry is visible on both pipeline views.
verify: Search both views for the submission reference.
Pass when the entry appears on both the underwriter and manager views.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every inbound facultative submission received through any channel in the period.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the submission to allocation of the unique facultative reference.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cedant, broker, insured, location, occupancy, sums insured and period populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents attached equal the documents listed as received in the broker email.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Receipt date and channel recorded so turnaround is measured from the right point.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions received without a slip logged with the request raised to the broker.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions registered in the period and their attached documents.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a received submission document is not attached under the allocated reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative underwriter decides whether an incomplete submission is registered or returned.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Unique reference allocated with cedant, insured, location and receipt date captured.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation submission record with documents in the document repository.

steps.title: Create the submission record and allocate the facultative reference
sop: Create the submission record in the underwriting workstation.
Allocate the unique facultative reference from the sequence.
Confirm the reference is not already in use.
Done when the record exists with a unique facultative reference.
verify: Search the workstation for duplicate references.
Pass when the allocated reference is unique in the workstation.

steps.title: Capture cedant, broker, insured and risk detail
sop: Capture cedant, placing broker, insured name and risk location.
Capture occupancy, sums insured and the period requested.
Query the broker where a core field is absent.
Done when all core submission fields are captured or queried.
verify: Check the captured fields against the broker submission email.
Pass when the captured fields agree with the broker submission.

steps.title: Attach every received document under the reference
sop: Attach the slip, schedule of values, loss history and survey reports.
Name each document so its type is identifiable.
Store the attachments in the document repository under the reference.
Done when every received document is attached under the reference.
verify: Count attached documents against the documents listed as sent.
Pass when every listed document is attached under the reference.

steps.title: Record the receipt date and channel
sop: Record the date and time the submission was received.
Record the channel it arrived through.
Use the receipt timestamp as the start of the turnaround clock.
Done when receipt date, time and channel are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded receipt time with the broker email timestamp.
Pass when the recorded receipt time matches the inbound message time.

steps.title: Confirm the reference is used in subsequent correspondence
sop: Quote the facultative reference in the acknowledgement to the broker.
Set the reference as the subject key for the submission thread.
Correct correspondence that omits the reference.
Done when the reference is in use on the submission correspondence.
verify: Check outbound correspondence on the submission for the reference.
Pass when outbound correspondence quotes the facultative reference.

steps.title: Release the registered submission for triage
sop: Set the submission status to registered and ready for triage.
Confirm the record appears in the triage queue.
Flag incomplete registrations to the facultative underwriter.
Done when the submission is released into the triage queue.
verify: Open the triage queue and locate the submission.
Pass when the registered submission appears in the triage queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: The specific data items missing from the submission that are needed to rate the risk.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the gap to the quote deadline for this submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Item requested, reason needed, required-by date and pending status populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items requested equal the gaps identified in the completeness review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Information request and each chase recorded against the submission with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items still outstanding at the deadline logged with the decision to proceed or decline.
generic.Test population: All information requests raised on facultative submissions in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where information remains outstanding at the deadline with no chase recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative underwriter decides whether to quote with limitation or decline for data.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Itemised information request logged with a required-by date and a pending status.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation submission record with the email request attached.

steps.title: List precisely which items are missing from the submission
sop: List each missing item such as values breakdown, COPE data or survey report.
Avoid general requests for more information.
Cross-check the list against the completeness review output.
Done when every missing item is listed individually.
verify: Compare the item list with the completeness review gaps.
Pass when every identified gap appears as a listed item.

steps.title: State why each item is needed and its required-by date
sop: State the rating or appraisal step each item unblocks.
Set the required-by date that protects the quote timeline.
Mark which items are essential and which are desirable.
Done when every item has a reason and a required-by date.
verify: Check each item carries a reason and a date.
Pass when no requested item lacks a reason or a required-by date.

steps.title: Send the request to the broker by email
sop: Send the itemised request to the broker contact of record.
Quote the submission reference in the request.
Copy the request to the submission record.
Done when the request is sent and copied to the submission.
verify: Check the sent request is attached to the submission record.
Pass when the submission holds a copy of the sent request.

steps.title: Set the submission to pending-information status
sop: Set the workstation status to pending information.
Confirm the quote clock treats the pending period correctly.
Record the date the status was set.
Done when the submission is in pending-information status.
verify: Open the submission and check the status and pending start date.
Pass when the submission shows pending-information status with a date.

steps.title: Chase outstanding items before the quote deadline
sop: Track which requested items remain outstanding.
Chase the broker before the required-by date and again before the deadline.
Record each chase with its date.
Done when every outstanding item has a recorded chase.
verify: Match the chase log against the outstanding item list.
Pass when every outstanding item has at least one recorded chase.

steps.title: Close the request and record the outcome for each item
sop: Mark each item received, waived or still outstanding at the deadline.
Decide whether to quote with limitation or decline for data.
Record the decision on the submission.
Done when every requested item carries a closing outcome.
verify: Read the outcome for each requested item.
Pass when no requested item is left without a closing outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every registered facultative submission screened against appetite before technical work starts.
generic.In-scope period: From triage screening to the pass or quick-decline decision on the submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class, occupancy, territory, appetite rule tested and screening outcome populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Screening outcomes recorded equal the submissions passing through triage.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Appetite check evidenced on the file with the appetite version referenced.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quick declines logged with the reason code and the specific rule triggered.
generic.Test population: All submissions screened against appetite in the period, passed and declined.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a decline is recorded without a reason code and rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter reviews borderline risks before a quick decline is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Appetite screening outcome with a reason code recorded for every decline.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation screening record with decline advice filed in the repository.

steps.title: Test the risk against class, occupancy and territory appetite rules
sop: Test the submission against class, occupancy and territory appetite rules.
Do this before any technical or pricing work begins.
Record which rules were tested and the appetite version used.
Done when the submission is tested against all three appetite dimensions.
verify: Check the appetite version cited on the screening record.
Pass when the screening cites the current appetite version.

steps.title: Test the risk against excluded perils and prohibited classes
sop: Check the risk against the excluded peril list and prohibited class list.
Check the cedant against the no-write list.
Record the specific rule triggered for any match.
Done when exclusion and prohibition checks are recorded.
verify: Check the rule cited for each exclusion match.
Pass when every exclusion match cites the specific rule triggered.

steps.title: Quick-decline prohibited risks with a reason code
sop: Quick-decline anything matching a prohibited or no-write rule.
Record a decline reason code and a free-text rationale.
Do not progress the submission to appraisal.
Done when every prohibited risk is declined with a reason code.
verify: List declines against reason codes and rationale.
Pass when every decline carries both a reason code and a rationale.

steps.title: Refer borderline risks to the reinsurance underwriter
sop: Review submissions that are borderline against appetite.
Decide whether to decline or progress with conditions.
Record the decision and reasoning on the submission.
Done when every borderline risk has a recorded decision.
verify: Check borderline submissions for a recorded underwriter decision.
Pass when no borderline submission progressed without a decision.

steps.title: Issue the decline advice to the broker within the service standard
sop: Issue the decline advice quoting the submission reference.
Send it within the service standard from receipt.
File the advice in the repository against the submission.
Done when the decline advice is issued and filed.
verify: Compare the advice send date with the receipt date.
Pass when the decline advice was issued within the service standard.

steps.title: Pass in-appetite submissions forward with the appetite check evidenced
sop: Set the status of in-appetite submissions to progress for appraisal.
Attach the appetite check evidence to the submission file.
Confirm the appraisal team can see the screening outcome.
Done when in-appetite submissions progress with evidence attached.
verify: Open a progressed submission and check the screening evidence.
Pass when the appetite check evidence is visible on the progressed file.

generic.Defined scope/population: The submission data set covering values, locations, exposure detail and loss history.
generic.In-scope period: The loss history years required plus the period of cover requested.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Address, occupancy, construction, year built, protection and loss detail populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Schedule total insured values reconcile to the values quoted in the slip.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completeness conclusion recorded with the data limitations carried forward.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Blank, zero or default rating fields logged rather than silently accepted.
generic.Test population: Every location row and every loss year in the submission data set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where schedule values do not reconcile to the slip without an explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative underwriter decides whether to appraise with limitation or request more data.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Completeness check recorded with value reconciliation and a gap list.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation completeness record with the Excel validation workbook.

steps.title: Reconcile schedule total insured values to the slip
sop: Total the insured values in the schedule of values.
Compare the total with the values quoted in the slip.
Record the difference and investigate anything material.
Done when schedule values are reconciled to the slip.
verify: Recompute the schedule total independently.
Pass when the recomputed total agrees with the slip values.

steps.title: Check every location has rating-grade detail
sop: Check each location for address, occupancy, construction and year built.
Check protection detail is sufficient to rate the location.
List locations missing any of these attributes.
Done when every location is checked for rating-grade detail.
verify: Count locations missing attributes against the total location count.
Pass when the missing-attribute list covers every deficient location.

steps.title: Check the loss history covers the required years with status
sop: Check the loss history covers the required number of years.
Check each loss shows date, amount, valuation date and open or closed status.
List years or fields that are missing.
Done when the loss history is checked for coverage and completeness.
verify: Count the years supplied against the required number of years.
Pass when the supplied years meet the requirement or the shortfall is listed.

steps.title: Flag blank, zero or default values in key rating fields
sop: Run the quality rules over the key rating fields in the data quality tool.
Flag blanks, zeros and default codes rather than accepting them.
Quantify the insured value affected by each flag.
Done when every key rating field issue is flagged and quantified.
verify: Check the flagged rows carry a quantified value impact.
Pass when every flag states the insured value affected.

steps.title: Compile the gap list for the broker information request
sop: Compile the gaps into a single itemised list.
Mark which gaps block rating and which can be worked around.
Pass the list to the facultative underwriter for the broker request.
Done when the gap list is compiled and passed on.
verify: Compare the gap list with the flags and missing-attribute list.
Pass when every flag and missing attribute appears on the gap list.

steps.title: Record the completeness conclusion and data limitations
sop: Record whether the data is sufficient to appraise.
State the data limitations to be carried into the appraisal.
File the conclusion against the submission record.
Done when the conclusion and limitations are recorded on the submission.
verify: Open the appraisal file and check the limitations are visible.
Pass when the recorded limitations are carried forward to the appraisal.

generic.Defined scope/population: The individual risk hazard characteristics, quality and underlying coverage being appraised.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover offered, using survey and hazard data current at appraisal.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Occupancy, construction, protection, natural-peril exposure and underlying terms populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Locations appraised equal the locations in the validated schedule of values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Survey or risk report referenced and dated in the appraisal record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Hazards falling in an excluded class logged and the appraisal stopped.
generic.Test population: All material locations and hazards in the risk being appraised.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the appraisal proceeds on a hazard that falls in an excluded class.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter decides on hazards near the boundary of excluded classes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hazard appraisal covering occupancy, construction, protection and natural peril.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation appraisal record with survey reports in the repository.

steps.title: Assess occupancy, construction and protection from the survey and schedule
sop: Read the survey report and schedule for occupancy, construction and protection.
Record the hazard grade for each material location.
Note exposure to adjacent risks and shared occupancies.
Done when occupancy, construction and protection are assessed for material locations.
verify: Check the assessment cites the survey report and its date.
Pass when the appraisal cites a dated survey or risk report.

steps.title: Assess natural-peril exposure at each location
sop: Read the flood zone, windstorm and earthquake exposure for each location.
Record the hazard band for each peril at each material location.
Note where hazard data is unavailable for a location.
Done when natural-peril exposure is recorded for material locations.
verify: Count locations with peril bands against material location count.
Pass when every material location carries a natural-peril assessment.

steps.title: Review the underlying policy terms being reinsured
sop: Review the underlying sub-limits, deductibles and coverage extensions.
Identify extensions that widen the exposure beyond the base cover.
Record the terms that drive the reinsured exposure.
Done when the underlying terms are reviewed and recorded.
verify: Check the review covers sub-limits, deductibles and extensions.
Pass when all three underlying elements are addressed in the review.

steps.title: Stop the appraisal where a hazard falls in an excluded class
sop: Compare the identified hazards with the excluded class list.
Stop the appraisal where an excluded hazard is present.
Record the rule triggered and refer for a decline decision.
Done when excluded hazards are identified and the appraisal is stopped.
verify: Check appraisals that continued for excluded hazard matches.
Pass when no appraisal continued past an excluded-class hazard.

steps.title: Summarise the hazard conclusion in the Excel appraisal workbook
sop: Summarise the hazard grade, natural peril exposure and underlying terms.
State the risk quality conclusion for pricing and line sizing.
List the evidence relied on with its date.
Done when the hazard conclusion is summarised with evidence listed.
verify: Check every conclusion statement cites its evidence.
Pass when no conclusion is stated without cited evidence.

steps.title: File the appraisal against the submission in the repository
sop: File the appraisal and survey reports against the submission reference.
Record the appraisal date and appraiser.
Link the appraisal to the pricing and accumulation steps.
Done when the appraisal is filed with date, appraiser and links.
verify: Open the filed appraisal and check the date and evidence links.
Pass when the filed appraisal carries its date and evidence links.

generic.Defined scope/population: The candidate facultative risk added to the in-force portfolio accumulation position.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover offered, modelled against the current in-force exposure set.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Peril, zone, marginal PML at both return periods and remaining capacity populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-addition PML equals the pre-addition position plus the marginal impact reported.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Marginal impact stored with the model version and exposure as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Marginal impacts breaching remaining capacity logged and referred before progressing.
generic.Test population: All affected perils and zones for the candidate risk location.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a risk progresses on a marginal impact that breaches remaining zonal capacity.
generic.Exception handling path: Catastrophe and Exposure Manager refers capacity-breaching risks before pricing is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Marginal PML impact by peril and zone recorded for the candidate risk.
generic.Evidence location: Moody's RMS marginal impact run with the Excel capacity summary on the risk file.

steps.title: Add the candidate risk to the accumulation model in Moody's RMS
sop: Load the candidate risk exposure into the accumulation model.
Apply the contemplated share, limit and deductible at load.
Select the approved model version and peril region set.
Done when the candidate risk is loaded with its contemplated terms.
verify: Compare the loaded terms with the contemplated line.
Pass when the loaded share, limit and deductible match the contemplated terms.

steps.title: Re-run the affected peril and zone aggregate
sop: Re-run the accumulation for the perils and zones the risk affects.
Record the run reference and exposure as-at date.
Keep the pre-addition position for comparison.
Done when the post-addition run is complete for all affected zones.
verify: Check the run covers every peril the risk is exposed to.
Pass when no exposed peril is missing from the run.

steps.title: Report the marginal PML change at 1-in-100 and 1-in-250
sop: Calculate the marginal change in occurrence PML at both return periods.
Express the change in monetary terms and as a percentage of the position.
Report it separately from the total portfolio position.
Done when the marginal change is reported at both return periods.
verify: Add the marginal impact to the pre-addition position.
Pass when the sum equals the reported post-addition position.

steps.title: Compare the post-addition position with remaining capacity
sop: Retrieve remaining zonal and per-peril capacity for the affected zones.
Compare the post-addition position with each limit.
Flag any zone where the limit would be breached.
Done when the post-addition position is compared with every affected limit.
verify: Check every affected zone appears in the comparison.
Pass when no affected zone is missing from the capacity comparison.

steps.title: Identify correlated existing exposure near the same location
sop: Search the in-force portfolio for exposure at or near the risk location.
Report the correlated exposure and its contribution to the zone position.
Note where a single event would hit both positions.
Done when correlated nearby exposure is identified and reported.
verify: Check the search radius used is the agreed correlation distance.
Pass when the search used the agreed correlation distance.

steps.title: Record the marginal impact figures on the risk file
sop: Record the marginal PML figures and capacity comparison on the risk file.
Record the model version, run reference and exposure as-at date.
Refer where the impact breaches remaining capacity.
Done when the marginal impact and references are on the risk file.
verify: List progressed risks against capacity breach flags.
Pass when no capacity-breaching risk progressed without a referral.

generic.Defined scope/population: The candidate risk rate compared with a comparable set from the bound book and treaty pricing.
generic.In-scope period: The bound book period used to select comparables plus the expiring year for renewals.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Occupancy, size band, territory, peril exposure and rate populated per comparable.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Comparable count and their premium totals tie to the warehouse extract used.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark conclusion stored with the comparable set and extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rates below the comparable range logged with a written justification.
generic.Test population: The selected comparable risks and the treaty rate for the same class.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a rate below the comparable range carries no written justification.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary refers unjustified below-range rates to the facultative underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Comparable set with an adjusted rate comparison for the candidate risk.
generic.Evidence location: Data warehouse comparable extract with the Excel benchmark workbook on the risk file.

steps.title: Select comparable risks from the bound book in the data warehouse
sop: Select comparables by occupancy, size band, territory and peril exposure.
Set a minimum comparable count for the conclusion to be meaningful.
Record the selection criteria and extract date.
Done when a comparable set is selected with recorded criteria.
verify: Count the comparables selected against the minimum count.
Pass when the comparable set meets the minimum count or the shortfall is stated.

steps.title: Compare the proposed rate with the comparable set
sop: Express the proposed rate per mille or rate-on-line on the same basis as comparables.
Show the proposed rate against the comparable range and median.
Note where the proposed rate sits in the distribution.
Done when the proposed rate is positioned against the comparable set.
verify: Recompute the comparable median from the extract.
Pass when the recomputed median matches the workbook figure.

steps.title: Compare the proposed rate with the treaty rate for the same class
sop: Retrieve the treaty rate applicable to the same class.
Compare the facultative rate with the treaty rate.
Note where facultative pricing undercuts the treaty for the same exposure.
Done when the treaty comparison is complete and recorded.
verify: Check the treaty rate used is for the same class and period.
Pass when the treaty rate cited matches the class and period.

steps.title: Adjust the comparison for deductible, limit and coverage differences
sop: Adjust comparable rates for deductible, limit and coverage differences.
State the adjustment factor applied to each comparable.
Recompute the comparable range on the adjusted basis.
Done when the comparison is stated on an adjusted like-for-like basis.
verify: Check every comparable carries an adjustment factor or a stated no-adjustment.
Pass when no comparable is used without an adjustment decision.

steps.title: State rate movement versus expiring for renewal risks
sop: Retrieve the expiring rate where the risk is a renewal.
State the rate movement in percentage terms.
Explain the movement against exposure and loss experience change.
Done when rate movement versus expiring is stated for renewals.
verify: Check the expiring rate cited matches the prior-year record.
Pass when the cited expiring rate matches the prior-year bound record.

steps.title: Record the benchmark conclusion and any deviation justification
sop: Record whether the proposed rate is inside, above or below the adjusted range.
Write a justification where the rate sits below the range.
File the conclusion and comparable set on the risk file.
Done when the conclusion and any justification are filed.
verify: List below-range rates against written justifications.
Pass when every below-range rate carries a written justification.

generic.Defined scope/population: The facultative placement being bound with its agreed share, limit, deductible and premium.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover being bound, effective from the agreed inception date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Share, limit, deductible, period, premium and authority reference populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bound terms equal the negotiated terms recorded on the risk file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bind date, terms and authority reference recorded within 24 hours of the decision.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Outstanding subjectivities logged with the decision to bind, waive or hold.
generic.Test population: All facultative placements bound in the period and their subjectivity status.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a placement is bound with an unsatisfied subjectivity outstanding.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager approves any bind where a subjectivity is waived rather than satisfied.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Bound placement with share, limit, deductible, period and premium recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system placement record with the workstation risk file.

steps.title: Confirm all subjectivities are satisfied before binding
sop: List every subjectivity attached to the quote.
Confirm survey, values confirmation and sanctions clearance are satisfied.
Hold the bind where any subjectivity is outstanding.
Done when every subjectivity is satisfied or formally waived.
verify: Read the subjectivity list against the evidence held.
Pass when no subjectivity is outstanding at the bind point.

steps.title: Confirm the bind is within underwriter authority
sop: Compare class, limit and line size with the authority matrix.
Confirm the binder holds authority for all three.
Refer where any threshold is exceeded.
Done when the bind is confirmed within authority or referred.
verify: Check the authority reference cited against the current matrix.
Pass when the cited authority covers the class, limit and line bound.

steps.title: Bind the agreed share, limit, deductible, period and premium
sop: Bind exactly the terms negotiated and recorded on the risk file.
Enter share, limit, deductible, period and premium without rounding.
Do not apply any term that was not agreed.
Done when the placement is bound on the agreed terms.
verify: Compare bound terms with the negotiated terms on the risk file.
Pass when every bound term matches the negotiated record.

steps.title: Issue the binding confirmation to broker and cedant the same day
sop: Issue the binding confirmation stating share, limit, deductible and premium.
Send to both the broker and the cedant on the day of binding.
Record the send date and recipients.
Done when the confirmation is issued to both parties on the bind day.
verify: Compare the confirmation send date with the bind date.
Pass when the confirmation was sent on the day of binding.

steps.title: Record the bind date, terms and authority reference within 24 hours
sop: Record the bind date and time on the workstation risk file.
Record the bound terms and the authority reference relied on.
Escalate where the record cannot be completed within 24 hours.
Done when the bind record is complete within 24 hours of the decision.
verify: Compare the decision time with the record completion time.
Pass when the record was completed within 24 hours of the decision.

steps.title: Hand the bound placement to booking in the administration system
sop: Notify the analyst team that the placement is bound and ready to book.
Attach the binding confirmation and the risk file references.
Confirm the booking record is created against the bind.
Done when the bound placement is handed over for booking.
verify: Check a booking record exists for the bound placement.
Pass when every bound placement has a corresponding booking record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Remaining capacity for the peril, zone, cedant and class relevant to the facultative placement.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover contemplated, checked as at the capacity confirmation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Peril, zone, cedant, class, committed exposure and remaining capacity populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Committed exposure equals bound plus signed plus quoted-not-bound positions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confirmed capacity figure recorded with the date it was checked.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Capacity shortfalls logged with the decision to reduce, refer or decline.
generic.Test population: All perils, zones, cedant and class limits touched by the contemplated placement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where quoted-but-unbound lines are excluded from the committed capacity figure.
generic.Exception handling path: Catastrophe and Exposure Manager refers shortfalls to the facultative underwriter before quoting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Remaining peril and zone capacity confirmed and dated for the risk.
generic.Evidence location: Moody's RMS capacity view with the administration system committed exposure extract.

steps.title: Check remaining peril and zone capacity at the risk location
sop: Identify the perils and zones the risk location falls in.
Retrieve the approved limit and current position for each.
Calculate the remaining capacity per peril and zone.
Done when remaining capacity is calculated for every affected peril and zone.
verify: Check the limits used are the current approved limits.
Pass when the limits used come from the current limits register.

steps.title: Check remaining cedant and class capacity in the administration system
sop: Retrieve the cedant aggregate limit and the class limit.
Retrieve committed exposure against each.
Calculate remaining capacity for cedant and class.
Done when remaining cedant and class capacity are calculated.
verify: Recompute remaining capacity from limit less committed exposure.
Pass when the recomputed remaining capacity matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Include quoted-but-unbound lines in the committed figure
sop: Extract lines quoted but not yet bound for the affected zones and cedant.
Add them to the committed exposure figure.
Note the expiry of each quote so lapsed quotes are released.
Done when quoted-not-bound lines are included in committed exposure.
verify: Compare committed exposure with and without quoted-not-bound lines.
Pass when the committed figure includes quoted-not-bound positions.

steps.title: Confirm retrocession in force covers the contemplated net position
sop: Apply the in-force retro programme to the contemplated gross position.
Confirm the resulting net position sits inside the net limit.
Flag where retro cover is exhausted for the affected peril.
Done when the net position after retro is confirmed against the net limit.
verify: Check the retro structure applied is the in-force programme.
Pass when the applied retro structure matches the in-force programme.

steps.title: Flag any capacity shortfall for the contemplated line
sop: Compare the contemplated line with remaining capacity on every dimension.
Flag every dimension where the line exceeds remaining capacity.
Propose a reduced line or refer where a shortfall exists.
Done when every capacity shortfall is flagged with a proposed response.
verify: Match flags against dimensions where the line exceeds capacity.
Pass when every shortfall dimension carries a flag and response.

steps.title: Record the confirmed available capacity figure and check date
sop: Record the confirmed available capacity by peril, zone, cedant and class.
Record the date and time the check was performed.
File the confirmation on the risk file for the line decision.
Done when the confirmed capacity and check date are recorded.
verify: Open the risk file and check the capacity figure and date.
Pass when the risk file holds a dated confirmed capacity figure.

generic.Defined scope/population: The appraisal decision on the facultative risk being accepted, declined or countered.
generic.In-scope period: The 24 hours following the decision in which the record must be completed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision, hazard reasoning, pricing reasoning, accumulation reasoning and links populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Linked pricing and accumulation outputs match those held on the risk file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision record stored with the decision timestamp and linked outputs.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declines logged with a reason code and the appetite or technical rule that drove them.
generic.Test population: All facultative appraisal decisions recorded in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a decline is recorded without a reason code and a rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Underwriter reviews decisions where the rationale is not reproducible.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision recorded with rationale and links to pricing and accumulation outputs.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation decision record with the appraisal filed in the repository.

steps.title: State the decision explicitly in the underwriting workstation
sop: Record the decision as accept, decline or counteroffer.
Attach the terms where the decision is accept or counteroffer.
Avoid ambiguous statuses such as pending after the decision is taken.
Done when the decision is recorded explicitly with its terms.
verify: Read the decision field on the risk record.
Pass when the decision is one of accept, decline or counteroffer.

steps.title: Set out the hazard reasoning behind the decision
sop: Summarise the hazard appraisal findings that drove the decision.
Cite the survey or hazard data relied on.
State which hazard factors were decisive.
Done when the hazard reasoning is recorded with cited evidence.
verify: Check the hazard reasoning cites the appraisal record.
Pass when the hazard reasoning cites the filed appraisal.

steps.title: Set out the pricing and accumulation reasoning
sop: Summarise the technical price, the benchmark position and the margin.
Summarise the marginal accumulation impact and capacity position.
State how each influenced the decision.
Done when pricing and accumulation reasoning are recorded.
verify: Compare cited figures with the pricing and accumulation outputs.
Pass when the cited figures match the outputs on the risk file.

steps.title: Record the reason code and rule for a decline
sop: Select the decline reason code from the agreed list.
Name the appetite or technical rule that drove the decline.
Add a free-text rationale alongside the code.
Done when every decline carries a reason code, rule and rationale.
verify: List declines against reason codes and rules.
Pass when no decline is recorded without a reason code and rule.

steps.title: State what would need to change for a counteroffer
sop: State the rate, deductible, limit or exclusion change required to accept.
Quantify the change rather than describing it loosely.
Set the validity of the counteroffer.
Done when every counteroffer states the quantified change required.
verify: Read counteroffers for quantified change statements.
Pass when every counteroffer quantifies the change required.

steps.title: Complete the record within 24 hours and link the outputs
sop: Link the decision to the pricing and accumulation outputs.
Complete the record within 24 hours of the decision.
File the decision in the repository against the submission.
Done when the decision record is complete, linked and filed.
verify: Compare the decision timestamp with the record completion time.
Pass when the record was completed within 24 hours of the decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: The bound facultative placement record covering parties, risk detail, terms and premium.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover bound, entered against the placement inception date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cedant, insured, location, class, period, share, limit, deductible and premium populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entered premium and share reconcile to the binding confirmation before release.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Slip and binding correspondence attached to the placement record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing inuring treaty linkages logged and resolved before release.
generic.Test population: Every field on the placement record compared against the binding confirmation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a placement is recorded without its inuring treaty linkage where one applies.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative underwriter resolves any difference between binder and system entry.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Placement booked with share, limit, deductible and premium matching the binder.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system placement record held in Sapiens ReinsurancePro.

steps.title: Create the placement record with parties, risk detail and period
sop: Create the placement record under the facultative reference.
Enter cedant, insured, risk location, class and period of cover.
Check the cedant record is the approved counterparty.
Done when the placement header is created with all identifying fields.
verify: Compare header fields with the binding confirmation.
Pass when every header field matches the binding confirmation.

steps.title: Enter accepted share, limit, deductible, premium and brokerage
sop: Enter the accepted share and the limit in monetary terms.
Enter the deductible, premium and brokerage as bound.
Do not round any bound value at entry.
Done when all financial terms are entered as bound.
verify: Compare entered financial terms with the binder.
Pass when every entered financial term matches the binder.

steps.title: Link the placement to any inuring treaty in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Identify any treaty that inures to the benefit of this placement.
Link the placement to the treaty so net retention calculates correctly.
Record where no inuring treaty applies.
Done when the inuring treaty link is set or absence is recorded.
verify: Check the net retention calculated after linking.
Pass when net retention reflects the inuring treaty structure.

steps.title: Reconcile entered premium and share to the binding confirmation
sop: Compare entered premium and share with the binding confirmation.
Record any difference and resolve it before release.
Recheck after any correction.
Done when premium and share are reconciled to the binder.
verify: Recompute the premium share from the accepted share and total premium.
Pass when the recomputed share matches the entered premium share.

steps.title: Attach the slip and binding correspondence to the record
sop: Attach the signed slip to the placement record.
Attach the binding confirmation and broker correspondence.
Confirm the attachments open and are legible.
Done when slip and binding correspondence are attached.
verify: Open each attachment from the placement record.
Pass when the slip and binding correspondence both open from the record.

steps.title: Release the placement record for accounting
sop: Release the record once reconciliation and linking are complete.
Record the release date and the releasing user.
Notify technical accounting the placement is live.
Done when the record is released with date and user recorded.
verify: List released placements for missing inuring treaty links.
Pass when no released placement is missing an applicable inuring link.

generic.Defined scope/population: The candidate coverage structures tested for the facultative risk being appraised.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover contemplated, using the validated exposure and loss data.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Structure definition, expected loss, standard deviation and PML populated per structure.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Structures evaluated equal the candidate structures defined at the outset.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Structure comparison stored with model version and data as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Structures rejected on modelling grounds logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All candidate share, excess layer, deductible and limit variants under consideration.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a preferred structure is recorded without a stated reason.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary refers structures whose loss cost cannot be modelled reliably.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Expected loss and PML calculated for each candidate coverage structure.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modeling platform structure run with the Excel comparison on the risk file.

steps.title: Define the candidate structures to be tested
sop: Define each candidate structure as share, excess layer, deductible and limit.
State the reason each structure is being considered.
Fix the candidate list before modelling starts.
Done when the candidate structure list is defined and fixed.
verify: Count the structures defined against those modelled.
Pass when every defined structure is carried into modelling.

steps.title: Estimate expected loss and standard deviation per structure
sop: Run each structure through the actuarial platform.
Produce expected loss and standard deviation for each.
Record the model version and data as-at date.
Done when expected loss and standard deviation exist per structure.
verify: Check every structure has both statistics recorded.
Pass when no structure is missing expected loss or standard deviation.

steps.title: Estimate probable maximum loss under each structure
sop: Estimate the probable maximum loss for each structure.
State the return period or scenario basis used.
Note where the structure caps the loss at the limit.
Done when PML is estimated for every candidate structure.
verify: Check the PML basis is stated consistently across structures.
Pass when all structures use the same stated PML basis.

steps.title: Test each structure at a defined severity and total-loss scenario
sop: Apply the agreed severity scenario to each structure.
Apply a total-loss scenario to each structure.
Record the recovery under each scenario for each structure.
Done when both scenarios are tested for every structure.
verify: Check the total-loss scenario recovery does not exceed the structure limit.
Pass when no scenario recovery exceeds the structure limit.

steps.title: Show expected loss cost as a percentage of premium per structure
sop: Express expected loss as a percentage of the premium for each structure.
Present the structures side by side on the same basis.
Highlight the structure with the best risk-adjusted position.
Done when loss cost as a percentage of premium is shown for each structure.
verify: Recompute the ratio for one structure from loss and premium.
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the workbook figure.

steps.title: Record the preferred structure and reasoning on the risk file
sop: Record which structure is preferred and why.
Reference the modelled statistics supporting the choice.
File the comparison with the risk file.
Done when the preferred structure and its reasoning are filed.
verify: Open the risk file and read the preferred structure reasoning.
Pass when the preferred structure carries a stated reason on the risk file.

generic.Defined scope/population: The facultative terms and commission under negotiation with the cedant or broker.
generic.In-scope period: From the opening offer to final agreement on terms and commission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Round date, party, revised terms, commission and technical price populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Final agreed terms equal the terms carried into the binding decision.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Negotiation rounds recorded with dates and the recheck against technical price.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Terms below the minimum acceptable price logged with the referral outcome.
generic.Test population: Every negotiation round recorded for the facultative risk.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where terms are agreed below the recorded minimum price without a referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager decides where terms fall below minimum price or outside authority.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Negotiation rounds recorded with final agreed terms and commission.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation negotiation log with the email round evidence attached.

steps.title: Record the technical rate and minimum acceptable rate before negotiating
sop: Record the technically indicated rate from the pricing output.
Record the minimum acceptable rate for the risk.
Do this before the first counter-offer is made.
Done when the technical and minimum rates are recorded on the risk file.
verify: Compare the recording date with the first negotiation round date.
Pass when the minimum rate was recorded before the first round.

steps.title: Open the negotiation at the technically indicated rate
sop: Open with the technically indicated rate and terms.
State the conditions and warranties attaching to the offer.
Record the opening position in the negotiation log.
Done when the opening offer is made and logged.
verify: Compare the opening offer with the technical rate.
Pass when the opening offer is at or above the technical rate.

steps.title: Record each counter-offer round with date, party and revised terms
sop: Log each round with the date, the party and the revised terms.
Attach the email evidence for each round.
Keep the log current as rounds happen rather than afterwards.
Done when every round is logged with date, party and terms.
verify: Count logged rounds against email evidence attached.
Pass when every logged round has matching correspondence.

steps.title: Recheck the deal against technical price when terms move
sop: Recheck the price whenever deductible, limit or coverage changes.
Record the revised technical price for the revised structure.
Stop the negotiation where the revised price cannot be met.
Done when every structural change carries a rechecked technical price.
verify: Match rechecks against rounds with structural changes.
Pass when every structural change has a matching price recheck.

steps.title: Confirm the commission or brokerage agreed is within the class limit
sop: Compare the agreed ceding commission or brokerage with the class limit.
Flag any element above the limit.
Refer where the limit is exceeded.
Done when the agreed commission is compared with the class limit.
verify: Check the class limit used is the current plan-year limit.
Pass when the comparison cites the current class commission limit.

steps.title: Stop and refer where terms fall below minimum or outside authority
sop: Compare the final agreed terms with the minimum price and authority limits.
Refer before agreeing anything below minimum or outside authority.
Record the referral outcome against the final round.
