Done when every out-of-bounds term carries a recorded referral outcome.
verify: Compare final agreed rate with the recorded minimum acceptable rate.
Pass when no below-minimum agreement lacks a referral outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: The facultative risk priced on both experience and exposure bases for the offered structure.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover offered, using loss history and exposure data as at the pricing date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss years used, severity curve, credibility weight and loads populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loss history used in the price ties to the validated submission loss listing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model version, curve reference and data as-at date recorded with the price.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks with insufficient loss history logged with the exposure-only basis applied.
generic.Test population: The offered structure priced on experience and exposure bases.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the price cannot be reproduced from the recorded model version and inputs.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary refers risks where neither basis produces a credible indication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Technical price and rate-on-line produced with experience and exposure indications.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modeling platform pricing run linked to the workstation risk record.

steps.title: Run experience rating on the risk own loss history where credible
sop: Load the validated loss history for the risk into the pricing platform.
Run the experience indication and state the years used.
Note where the history is too thin to be credible.
Done when the experience indication is produced or ruled non-credible.
verify: Compare the loss history used with the validated submission listing.
Pass when the loss history used ties to the validated listing.

steps.title: Run exposure rating using the approved severity curve
sop: Select the approved severity curve for the occupancy and record its reference.
Apply the exposure profile to the offered structure.
Produce the exposure indication.
Done when the exposure indication is produced with its curve reference.
verify: Check the curve reference against the approved curve list.
Pass when the curve used appears on the approved curve list.

steps.title: Blend the indications with a stated credibility weight
sop: Set the credibility weight between experience and exposure indications.
Justify the weight from the volume and stability of the history.
Produce the blended loss cost.
Done when the blended loss cost and its weight are recorded.
verify: Recompute the blend from the two indications and the weight.
Pass when the recomputed blend matches the platform output.

steps.title: Load for expenses, brokerage, cat load and cost of capital
sop: Apply the expense and brokerage loads for the class.
Apply the cat load where the location carries natural-peril exposure.
Apply the cost-of-capital load to derive the technical price.
Done when all loads are applied and the technical price is derived.
verify: Check each load applied against the current plan-year load set.
Pass when all loads applied come from the current plan-year set.

steps.title: Derive the technical price and rate-on-line
sop: Express the loaded indication as a technical premium and rate-on-line.
State the basis the rate-on-line is expressed on.
Compare against the class minimum rate-on-line.
Done when the technical price and rate-on-line are derived.
verify: Recompute rate-on-line from technical premium and limit.
Pass when the recomputed rate-on-line matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Record model version, inputs and data as-at date for reproducibility
sop: Record the model version, curve reference and input data set used.
Record the data as-at date for the pricing run.
Link the run to the workstation risk record.
Done when version, inputs and as-at date are recorded and linked.
verify: Re-run the price from the recorded version and inputs.
Pass when the re-run reproduces the recorded technical price.

generic.Defined scope/population: The facultative risk submission checked for values, location and loss-history completeness.
generic.In-scope period: The required loss-history period plus the period of cover requested.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Split sums insured, geocodable addresses, loss detail and underlying terms populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Split sums insured add to the total sums insured stated in the slip.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completeness assessment recorded against the submission with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each gap logged as a broker information request or accepted with limitation.
generic.Test population: Every site, value split and loss year in the risk submission.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an identified gap has no broker information request raised.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative underwriter decides whether to appraise with limitation or hold for data.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Values, location and loss-history completeness assessed and recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation submission record with the Excel completeness workbook.

steps.title: Confirm sums insured are split by building, contents and business interruption
sop: Check the sums insured are split rather than given as a single total.
Check the split adds to the total stated in the slip.
Record any site given as a single combined figure.
Done when the value split is checked for every site.
verify: Add the value splits and compare with the slip total.
Pass when the split values add to the slip total.

steps.title: Confirm full location detail is present for every site
sop: Check every site has a full address usable for geocoding.
Check the postcode or equivalent is present.
List sites without geocodable detail.
Done when every site is checked for geocodable location detail.
verify: Count sites lacking geocodable detail against total sites.
Pass when every deficient site appears on the gap list.

steps.title: Confirm the loss history covers the required period with status
sop: Check the loss history covers the required number of years.
Check each loss carries date, amount and open or closed status.
List missing years or incomplete loss records.
Done when the loss history is checked for period and completeness.
verify: Compare the years supplied with the years required.
Pass when the supplied period meets the requirement or the gap is listed.

steps.title: Confirm the underlying wording, deductibles and sub-limits are supplied
sop: Check the underlying policy wording is supplied.
Check deductibles and sub-limits are stated for each coverage.
List any coverage where the underlying terms are missing.
Done when the underlying terms are checked for completeness.
verify: Check the underlying terms cover every coverage being reinsured.
Pass when no reinsured coverage lacks its underlying terms.

steps.title: Log each gap as a broker information request
sop: Log each identified gap as an itemised broker request.
State the required-by date for each item.
Hold the appraisal until items are received or accepted with limitation.
Done when every gap is logged as a broker request.
verify: Match the request list against the identified gap list.
Pass when every identified gap has a matching broker request.

steps.title: Record the completeness assessment on the submission
sop: Record whether the submission is complete enough to appraise.
State the limitations to be carried into the appraisal.
File the assessment against the submission with its date.
Done when the completeness assessment and limitations are recorded.
verify: Open the submission and check the assessment and its date.
Pass when the submission holds a dated completeness assessment.

generic.Defined scope/population: The terms, conditions and proposed line size for the facultative risk being offered.
generic.In-scope period: The period of cover offered, using capacity as at the terms-setting date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attachment, limit, deductible, conditions, warranties and line size populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Monetary line size equals the proposed share applied to the limit offered.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Terms and line size recorded on the risk file with the capacity check referenced.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines exceeding the per-risk limit logged with the referral raised.
generic.Test population: The proposed line tested against the per-risk limit and remaining zonal capacity.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a proposed line exceeds the per-risk limit without a recorded referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager decides lines above the per-risk limit or outside delegated authority.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Terms, conditions and proposed line size recorded with a capacity check reference.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation risk file with the administration system capacity position.

steps.title: Set the share or excess layer with attachment, limit and deductible
sop: Set the structure as a share or an excess layer.
State attachment, limit and deductible in monetary terms.
Use the preferred structure from the loss potential evaluation.
Done when the structure is set with attachment, limit and deductible.
verify: Compare the set structure with the preferred structure on file.
Pass when the set structure matches the preferred structure or states why not.

steps.title: Set the conditions, warranties and exclusions to attach to the offer
sop: Set the conditions and warranties required by the hazard appraisal.
Attach the mandated exclusions for the class.
State each condition precisely enough to be enforced.
Done when conditions, warranties and exclusions are set for the offer.
verify: Check the mandated exclusion set is present in the offer terms.
Pass when every mandated exclusion appears in the offer terms.

steps.title: Size the line against remaining zonal capacity and the per-risk limit
sop: Size the line from remaining capacity rather than the amount requested.
Compare the proposed line with the per-risk limit.
Reduce the line where capacity does not support the request.
Done when the line is sized against capacity and the per-risk limit.
verify: Compare the proposed line with the confirmed capacity figure.
Pass when the proposed line sits inside the confirmed capacity.

steps.title: Confirm the proposed line and terms are within delegated authority
sop: Compare the line, limit and class with the authority matrix.
Refer where any threshold is exceeded.
Record the authority reference relied on.
Done when the line and terms are confirmed within authority or referred.
verify: Check the authority reference against the current matrix version.
Pass when the cited authority covers the class, limit and line proposed.

steps.title: Record the terms and line size on the risk file
sop: Record the structure, conditions, exclusions and proposed line size.
Reference the capacity check that supports the line.
Date the record so the capacity basis is traceable.
Done when terms and line size are recorded with the capacity reference.
verify: Open the risk file and check the capacity reference is present.
Pass when the recorded terms cite the supporting capacity check.

steps.title: Release the terms for the offer to the broker
sop: Confirm all referrals raised on the terms are decided.
Release the terms for the offer once decided.
Record the release date and who released it.
Done when the terms are released with all referrals decided.
verify: List open referrals at the terms release date.
Pass when no referral remained open when the terms were released.

generic.Defined scope/population: The staged cedant exposure file being cleansed before modelling.
generic.In-scope period: The exposure as-at date of the staged file being cleansed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: TIV, occupancy code, construction code, currency and unit fields populated and valid.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deduplicated total insured value still ties to the cedant submission total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Data quality report stored with pass rate by rule and defaulted-row counts.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows failing quality rules logged with the default or correction applied.
generic.Test population: Every row in the staged cedant exposure file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the cleansed TIV does not reconcile back to the submission total.
generic.Exception handling path: CAT Modeler agrees the conservative default treatment for unknown codes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quality rule results with pass rate and defaulted-row counts for the cedant file.
generic.Evidence location: Data catalog quality tool run output with the Excel cleansing workbook in the warehouse.

steps.title: Run the standard quality rules over the staged file
sop: Run the rules for null TIV, zero values and invalid occupancy or construction codes.
Record the pass rate and failing row count per rule.
Keep the raw staged file unchanged for traceability.
Done when every standard quality rule has been run and scored.
verify: Check every rule in the standard set produced a result.
Pass when no standard rule is missing a result.

steps.title: Resolve duplicate location records
sop: Identify duplicate location rows on address and value attributes.
Remove duplicates keeping the most complete record.
Record how many rows were removed and their value.
Done when duplicates are resolved and the removals are recorded.
verify: Compare deduplicated TIV with the submission total.
Pass when the deduplicated TIV still ties to the submission total.

steps.title: Standardise currency and unit fields onto one basis
sop: Convert all values onto the agreed reporting currency and units.
Record the exchange rates and conversion date used.
Flag rows where the source currency is not stated.
Done when all values sit on a single currency and unit basis.
verify: Check for more than one currency remaining in the value fields.
Pass when all value fields are on one stated currency basis.

steps.title: Default unknown construction and occupancy codes conservatively
sop: Apply the agreed conservative default for unknown construction or occupancy.
Record how many rows were defaulted and the TIV affected.
Do not leave unknown codes unmapped going into the model.
Done when unknown codes are defaulted and the counts are recorded.
verify: Check no unknown code remains unmapped in the cleansed file.
Pass when every code in the cleansed file maps to a model code.

steps.title: Reconcile cleansed TIV back to the submission total
sop: Total the cleansed TIV and compare with the cedant submission total.
Explain any difference through removals, conversions or corrections.
Escalate an unexplained difference before the file is promoted.
Done when cleansed TIV is reconciled to the submission total.
verify: Read the reconciliation for unexplained differences.
Pass when no unexplained TIV difference remains.

steps.title: Produce the data quality report with residual limitations
sop: Produce the report showing pass rate by rule and defaulted-row counts.
State the residual limitations to carry into modelling.
Store the report with the cleansed exposure set in the warehouse.
Done when the quality report is produced and stored with the data.
verify: Open the report and check pass rates and limitations are stated.
Pass when the report states pass rate by rule and residual limitations.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every layer and treaty affected by the placement whose capacity is being confirmed.
generic.In-scope period: The in-force period of the affected layers and treaties at the check date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Layer, treaty, capacity used, capacity remaining and retro position populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Capacity used plus remaining equals the approved capacity for each layer.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Capacity position date-stamped so the underwriting decision cites a known point.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers with remaining capacity below the contemplated line highlighted and referred.
generic.Test population: All layers and treaties affected by the contemplated placement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where quoted-not-bound positions are excluded from the used capacity figure.
generic.Exception handling path: Catastrophe and Exposure Manager refers shortfalls to the underwriter before the line is set.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Used and remaining capacity by layer and treaty, shown gross and net of retro.
generic.Evidence location: Moody's RMS capacity output with the administration system in-force position extract.

steps.title: Identify every layer and treaty affected by the placement
sop: List the layers and treaties the contemplated placement touches.
Include treaties that inure to the placement.
Record the in-force period of each.
Done when every affected layer and treaty is listed.
verify: Check each listed treaty is in force for the placement period.
Pass when every listed treaty is in force for the period.

steps.title: Report capacity used and remaining for each layer and treaty
sop: Report used and remaining capacity per layer rather than in total only.
Show the approved capacity for each layer alongside the position.
Highlight layers close to exhaustion.
Done when used and remaining capacity are reported per layer and treaty.
verify: Add used and remaining and compare with approved capacity.
Pass when used plus remaining equals approved capacity for each layer.

steps.title: Include bound, signed and quoted-not-bound positions in the used figure
sop: Extract bound and signed positions from the administration system.
Add quoted-not-bound positions still within their validity.
Exclude lapsed quotes from the committed figure.
Done when the used figure includes bound, signed and live quoted positions.
verify: Compare the used figure with and without quoted-not-bound positions.
Pass when live quoted-not-bound positions are included in the used figure.

steps.title: Show the position gross and net of the inuring retro programme
sop: Apply the inuring retro programme to the gross position.
Show gross and net capacity used and remaining side by side.
Note where retro cover is exhausted for a peril.
Done when the position is shown gross and net of retro.
verify: Check the retro applied is the in-force programme.
Pass when the net position reflects the in-force retro programme.

steps.title: Highlight layers where remaining capacity is below the contemplated line
sop: Compare remaining capacity per layer with the contemplated line.
Highlight every layer where the line would not fit.
Propose a reduced line or refer for each highlighted layer.
Done when every shortfall layer is highlighted with a proposed response.
verify: Match highlights against layers with insufficient remaining capacity.
Pass when every insufficient layer is highlighted.

steps.title: Date-stamp and issue the capacity position
sop: Date-stamp the capacity position with the check date and time.
Issue it to the underwriter for the line decision.
File the position against the placement record.
Done when the dated capacity position is issued and filed.
verify: Check the position carries a date stamp when used for a decision.
Pass when the capacity position cited in the decision is date-stamped.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every geocoded location in the cedant exposure set awaiting peril hazard attributes.
generic.In-scope period: The exposure as-at date of the geocoded set being enriched.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Flood zone, windstorm and earthquake hazard attributes populated per location.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Locations enriched plus locations unattached equals the geocoded location count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Vendor dataset version and enrichment run date stored with the exposure set.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Locations that received no hazard attribute logged with the investigation outcome.
generic.Test population: All geocoded locations submitted to the hazard enrichment run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where hazard data comes from a vendor outside the approved list.
generic.Exception handling path: CAT Modeler investigates and re-runs where the attachment rate falls short materially.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Peril hazard attributes appended with the vendor dataset version recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Moody's RMS enriched exposure set stored in the data warehouse with the run log.

steps.title: Confirm the approved hazard data vendor and dataset version
sop: Select the approved catastrophe data provider dataset for the perils required.
Record the dataset version to be applied.
Reject any unapproved vendor source.
Done when the approved vendor and dataset version are confirmed.
verify: Check the vendor against the approved vendor list.
Pass when the selected vendor appears on the approved list.

steps.title: Append flood, windstorm and earthquake attributes to each location
sop: Run the enrichment over the geocoded exposure set.
Append flood zone, windstorm and earthquake attributes per location.
Keep unattached locations flagged rather than dropped.
Done when hazard attributes are appended across the exposure set.
verify: Count locations with attributes plus unattached against the total.
Pass when the counts reconcile to the geocoded location count.

steps.title: Report the percentage of locations that received hazard attributes
sop: Calculate the attachment rate by location count and by TIV.
Report the rate for each peril separately.
Compare with the expected attachment rate for the territory.
Done when attachment rates are reported per peril.
verify: Recompute one attachment rate from the enriched set.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the reported rate.

steps.title: Investigate any material shortfall in attachment
sop: Identify perils or territories where attachment fell materially short.
Investigate the cause such as geocode resolution or coverage gaps.
Re-run the enrichment where the cause can be corrected.
Done when every material shortfall has an investigated cause.
verify: Read the investigation notes against the shortfall list.
Pass when every material shortfall has a recorded cause.

steps.title: Spot-check enriched locations against the vendor source
sop: Select a sample of enriched locations across perils.
Compare the appended attribute with the vendor source value.
Record any mismatch and re-run where systematic.
Done when the sample spot-check is complete and recorded.
verify: Count sampled locations matching the vendor source.
Pass when the sampled attributes agree with the vendor source.

steps.title: Record the enrichment run date and dataset version with the exposure set
sop: Store the run date and dataset version with the enriched exposure set.
Store the attachment rate report alongside it.
Make the enriched set available for the model load.
Done when run date, version and attachment report are stored with the data.
verify: Open the stored exposure set metadata.
Pass when the metadata carries the run date and vendor dataset version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every peak zone whose modelled position is compared with the approved appetite limit.
generic.In-scope period: The accumulation run period using the exposure as-at date of the run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Peril, zone, modelled position, approved limit and breach size populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Zones assessed equal the peak zones in the approved limits register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Breach flags stored with the model version and exposure as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every breach and near-limit zone logged with the driving submissions attributed.
generic.Test population: All peak zones with modelled aggregate or occurrence PML in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a flagged breach is not attributed to the submissions or treaties driving it.
generic.Exception handling path: Catastrophe and Exposure Manager raises flags to underwriting the same day they arise.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Breach and near-limit flags produced per peak zone with the size of breach.
generic.Evidence location: Moody's RMS accumulation output published through the Power BI exposure report.

steps.title: Compare modelled PML by peak zone with the approved limit
sop: Load the accumulation output for aggregate and occurrence PML by peak zone.
Retrieve the approved limit for each zone from the limits register.
Compare the modelled position with the limit for every zone.
Done when every peak zone position is compared with its approved limit.
verify: Count zones compared against the limits register zone count.
Pass when every zone in the register has been compared.

steps.title: Flag zones above the limit and within the warning tolerance
sop: Flag every zone where the position exceeds the approved limit.
